raw.excerpt: Trilogy Federal drives innovative solutions for complex business challenges across financial management, healthcare, and government industries.
raw.description:
Trilogy Federal drives innovative solutions for complex business challenges across financial management, healthcare, and government industries. Our collaborative, client-first service approach, combined with our commitment to the rapid implementation of pragmatic solutions, has earned Trilogy an unparalleled reputation for delivering transformative results.

We are seeking an experienced Program Manager for a new part-time opportunity with an existing federal customer. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of experience with federal accounting or federal financial audit, which is essential to the successful performance of the program. The Program Manager will work closely with the client, the Program Partner, and subject matter experts to execute the program and will oversee all aspects of the Program. The Program Manager should have strong project management and leadership skills and proven responsibility for managing client engagements and leading others.

The chosen candidate will join a skilled team of professionals dedicated to our client’s compliance with established accounting, financial management and reporting requirements. Our team provides expert technical accounting services including SFFAS and Treasury financial management policy monitoring, development of accounting policies, procedures and process documentation, collaboration with subject matter experts to develop financial data visualizations and dashboards, developing presentations, white papers and graphic design support related to financial reporting.

This position may also involve business development support, such as proposal development and other capture activities, as assigned.

This position is 100% remote and part-time/hourly with an estimated average of 20 –25 hours per week (~ 20 hours supporting client engagement, with additional hours for business development as authorized).

Primary Responsibilities:

    • Develop and maintain project management documents including Project Management Plan, Project Schedule, Weekly Status Reports, Quality Assurance and Quality Control, among others.

    • Manage all work performed under the contract, overseeing the staff and the subject matter experts that support the program.

    • Develop documentation templates and protocols

    • Lead executive level meetings

    • Perform and oversee performance of accounting research

    • Develop presentations for client management

    • Develop policy and procedure templates and repository

    • Develop and oversee development of new or update accounting policies, procedures and process maps

    • Perform walk-through interviews of process owners

    • Design financial management dashboard(s) – identifying content and working with SMEs to develop.

    • Design presentation templates and graphic design tools and guidance

    • Develop training

Minimum Requirements:

    • Bachelors degree in Accounting

    • Minimum of 8 years of federal accounting or federal financial statement audit experience. 

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

    • The ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • CPA, CGFM or PMP is a plus.
To cut down on falsified applications and to avoid subjecting real candidates to screening by AI assistants, phone interviews at Trilogy require either a landline or a cellphone number backed by a physical SIM. We cannot conduct interviews with candidates who provide VOIP contact numbers (including Google Voice).
Trilogy Federal is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

raw.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

The Finance Systems team is seeking an experienced Netsuite Systems Manager with strong functional and IT support experience to join the team. In this individual contributor role you will be responsible for administration, configuration, and support for our Netsuite ERP system and associated Finance Business Systems. Additionally, you will be a Finance Systems thought leader and champion of best IT/functional practices, IT General controls, and process improvement automation. Reporting directly to Sr Director of Finance Systems, you will collaborate closely with Business Application, Sales Operations, IT, and our Finance team. This position is 100% remote.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Netsuite System Administration

  • Own day-to-day operations of NetSuite, and other Finance Business systems including hands on user support and troubleshooting.
  • Administer and support the NetSuite ERP system, focusing on Financial, Advanced Revenue Management (ARM), and Zone billing module
  • Perform system configuration, customization, upgrade and maintenance along with compliance in change management, ITGC, and SDLC processes.
  • Develop and maintain workflows, custom fields, and scripts.
  • Manage NetSuite integrations with other business systems.
  • Oversee user access management, SOD Reviews, and annual/quarterly review process to resolve segregation of duties conflicts.
  • Oversee the governance, change management, end to end maintenance including general ledger accounts, cost centers, products, and any other necessary structures to support the reporting needs of key stakeholders. Manage ticketing system for tracking open cases/change request to resolution
  • Optimize system settings, workflows, and customizations for maximum efficiency.
  • Ensure data integrity and compliance with SOX regulations.
  • Provide training and support to end-users.

Program Management

  • Manage/Configure finance transformation projects focusing primarily on the order to cash cycle, encompassing Lead/Opportunity, Contract Management, Quoting/CPQ, Order Management, Revenue Recognition, Billing, Credit, Collections/Disputes, and Cash Application processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Sales, Legal,Engineering, Finance and IT to gather requirements and implement solutions that enhance business processes.
  • Identify, scope, and prioritize projects based on business needs. Develop detailed project plans, including approach, timelines, milestones, and resources, ensuring on-time and within-budget project delivery.
  • Define data-driven frameworks and processes to identify, measure, and manage program success, focusing on business value, including benchmarking.
  • Ensure procedures, processes, and proper change controls are followed on all production changes and implementation projects
  • Work with sales operations and biz app teams on system enhancements.

Dashboard Creation and Reporting

  • Utilize NetSuite's native tools and our very own Grafana dashboard to create high-performing dashboards tailored to Finance needs.
  • Develop reports and visualizations to provide actionable insights from finance data.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in computer Science, information technology, accounting, finance or a related field.
  • 6+ years of progressive experience with as a Finance System Administrator with Netsuite and financial systems tools such as Zip, Avalara, Expensify etc
  • Hands-on IT support experience, including troubleshooting and resolving functional & technical issues.
  • Experience with data migration, data mapping, and data integration within Netsuite including the Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) module including Zone and Company billing module,and Salesforce integration.
  • Administrator-level knowledge of privileged access, content groups, multiple charts of accounts, dynamic approval chains, custom objects, tax codes, tolerances, custom workflows, supplier configuration, and report building
  • Knowledge of ITGCs and experience working in SOC, ISO, and SOX compliant environments
  • Demonstrated experience integrating accounting systems with Salesforce / SFDC, ideally including CPQ and experienced level with Netsuite Advanced Revenue Management (ARM)
  • Experience with project management concepts and tools such as Github, Monday.com and Miro.
  • Sharp analytical skills coupled with the ability to troubleshoot complex system issues with ease
  • Knowledge of core accounting processes such as order to cash, procure to pay, record to report.
  • Highly motivated with the ability to work in a rapidly changing global and remote environment
  • You work well in both a team environment and independently
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to speak cross-functionally

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United States, the Base compensation range for this role is $144,000 - $173,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

Our Client, an international e-commerce company with a strong presence in the USA, is looking for a highly skilled and experienced professional to fill an immediate opening for an Amazon Growth Manager for a full-time remote job.

As an Amazon Growth Manager, you will be responsible for accelerating sales performance and brand visibility across Amazon by driving high-quality traffic, improving organic rankings, and optimizing pricing and promotional strategies. This role focuses on strengthening core performance KPIs through data-driven decision-making, continuous optimization, and effective execution across the Amazon ecosystem.

You will take ownership of SKU-level growth, ensuring consistent performance improvement across the product portfolio while identifying opportunities to scale through new product launches and expansion initiatives. Working closely with the teams, you will develop and execute strategies that enhance discoverability, conversion, and profitability.

If you are a commercially minded strategist with hands-on experience managing Amazon traffic and sales, a strong analytical mindset, and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally to deliver measurable growth, we would love to hear from you.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience with Amazon.
  • A self-starter who enjoys working in a team and independently.
  • Leadership skills.
  • 100% focus on the company's brand and desire to grow.
  • Deep understanding of Amazon: Best Practices, listing performance metrics, search terms research & analysis.
  • Expert level knowledge of PPC + Pricing, Deals & Coupons strategies.
  • Data/sales driven mindset with the ability to make sales grow
  • Digital marketing experience and knowledge of external traffic tools are advantageous.
  • Expertise in tools like Helium 10, Data Dive, SellerBoard, etc.
  • Strong Excel skills, experience with dashboards, and advanced sales tracking tools.
  • Experience working with high-ticket products.
  • Experience in working with project management tools.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate closely with the Leadership Team to oversee Amazon operations.
  • Monitor and improve SKU-Level Performance, collaborating with the team for optimized results.
  • Coordinate new product launches, ensuring seamless market entry and brand consistency.
  • Manage pricing strategies, deals, discounts, and promotional activities to maximize brand performance.
  • Provide detailed reports on product performance metrics, offering and implementing suggestions for improvement.
  • Utilize PPC knowledge to guide paid marketing strategies and optimize ranking and ad spend.
  • Demonstrate strong data analysis skills to inform decision-making and strategy development.
  • Prioritize tasks effectively, focusing on impactful activities and minimizing time-consuming distractions.

Our benefits:

  • Work for a market-proven, fast-growing company.
  • Competitive salary and bonus opportunities.
  • Supportive work environment.
  • Fully remote work and flexible working hours (work from whatever place).

raw.description:
Req ID:395082

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Cybersecurity / IAM Engineer to join our team in Herndon (REMOTE), Virginia (US-VA), United States (US).

Job Summary:

The Cybersecurity / IAM Engineer is responsible for architecting, implementing, and maintaining advanced cybersecurity and identity and access management (IAM) solutions across all client environments, including cloud, IoT, edge, and data systems. This role is critical to ensuring that client meets and sustains compliance with cybersecurity, privacy, and risk management requirements, including RMF, IL4/IL5, and FedRAMP controls. The engineer leads the design and enforcement of secure authentication, authorization, and RBAC frameworks, supporting multi-factor authentication, single sign-on, and integration with providers. The Cybersecurity / IAM Engineer works closely with DevSecOps, software, and infrastructure teams to embed security best practices into all phases of the system lifecycle, including secure configuration baselines, continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and incident response. The position requires hands-on experience with IAM platforms, PKI, secure directory services, and the implementation of audit logging and compliance reporting. The engineer maintains comprehensive documentation, supports audit and ATO processes, and ensures that all client solutions are resilient, auditable, and optimized for operational readiness and regulatory compliance.

Job Duties:

  • Architect, implement, and maintain advanced IAM solutions, including RBAC, MFA, SSO, and integration with providers
  • Develop and enforce secure authentication and authorization frameworks for client's cloud, edge, and data environments
  • Lead the implementation of secure directory services, PKI, and certificate management for all client components
  • Support continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and incident response in compliance with DoD RMF, IL4/IL5, and FedRAMP requirements
  • Collaborate with DevSecOps, software, and infrastructure teams to embed security best practices throughout the system lifecycle
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation for IAM architectures, security controls, and compliance artifacts
  • Support audit, ATO, and risk management processes, including evidence collection and remediation of findings
  • Implement and monitor audit logging, access reviews, and compliance reporting for all client environments
  • Provide technical support for user provisioning, deprovisioning, and lifecycle management
  • Participate in security assessments, code reviews, and compliance audits as required by contract and SOW

Basic Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer, Electrical, or Electronics Engineering, or Mathematics with a concentration in computer science or equivalent.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience with cybersecurity engineering
  • Must be US Citizen with ability to obtain a Secret Clearance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing and managing IAM solutions in regulated or mission-critical DoD environments
  • Proficiency with RBAC, SSO, MFA, PKI, and secure directory services
  • Experience with DoD RMF, IL4/IL5, and FedRAMP cybersecurity and compliance requirements
  • Familiarity with AWS GovCloud, cloud security, and secure integration of edge/IoT devices
  • Strong documentation and communication skills, including the ability to produce compliance artifacts and technical guides
  • Experience supporting audit, ATO, and risk management processes for federal systems
  • Information Assurance Management (IAM) or Information Assurance Technical (IAT) or Information Assurance System Architect and Engineer (IASAE) Level I (position-based) per DoD 8570.1M

Ce à quoi ressembleront tes semaines

  • Déterminer les moyens techniques les plus appropriés pour atteindre les objectifs du projet en tenant compte des contraintes (techniques, budgétaires et temporelles);
  • Assurer une communication fluide avec les autres départements (design, art, production) pour une intégration optimale des différentes composantes du projet;
  • Assurer le suivi des échéanciers et des livrables en lien avec la planification technique initiale et anticiper les ajustements requis;
  • Identifier et proposer des solutions aux problématiques techniques pouvant impacter la production;
  • Veiller à l’optimisation du code et à la performance des systèmes pour assurer une fluidité et une stabilité optimales;
  • Organiser et animer des rencontres régulières avec son équipe pour suivre l’avancement, anticiper les risques et valider le respect des échéances;
  • Accompagner les programmeurs dans la résolution de problèmes techniques et fournir un support en cas de blocage;
  • Mobiliser, encadrer et soutenir son équipe directe en assurant leur coaching à travers le feedback en continu;
  • Participer au développement des compétences et de la relève interne pour son expertise métier en assurant un suivi de la performance rigoureux, le développement de plans de formations pertinents adaptés aux besoins et aux orientations stratégiques corporatifs;
  • Développer une relation de confiance avec le partenaire et agir comme point de contact dans son domaine d’expertise;
  • Participer aux revues de projet et aux post-mortems pour améliorer continuellement les processus et livrables;
  • Veiller à la satisfaction du partenaire en assurant une transparence et un suivi rigoureux des demandes et des ajustements nécessaires;
  • Participer aux échanges avec les autres leads et son Directeur pour partager les meilleures pratiques et innovations techniques;
  • Développer et optimiser, en collaboration avec son équipe, des outils et fonctionnalités réutilisables pour améliorer l’efficacité de son projet;
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des processus et méthodes de développement afin d’optimiser la productivité et la qualité des productions.

Ce que nous recherchons

  • Baccalauréat en informatique ou autre diplôme connexe jumelé à une expérience jugée équivalente;
  • Minimum de cinq (5) années d'expérience en programmation de jeu vidéo;
  • Expérience en tant que lead programmeur ou dans un poste similaire;
  • Bonne maîtrise du langage C++ et aptitudes en optimisation ;
  • Maîtrise du moteur de jeu Unreal, un atout important;
  • Bonne connaissance des différents niveaux matériaux et logiciels qui opèrent durant l'exécution d'un jeu vidéo;
  • Expérience en développement de jeu mobile (un atout important);
  • Excellente maîtrise de la langue française et anglaise (écrit et oral). Des habiletés en anglais sont requises pour la réalisation du travail comme nous collaborons avec des partenaires anglophones;
  • Habileté à voyager à l’extérieur du pays au besoin.

Ce que nous valorisons au sein de notre équipe

  • Capacité à anticiper et gérer les risques tout au long du développement;
  • Sens de l’organisation et de la priorisation pour garantir la livraison des projets dans les temps;
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en collaboration interdisciplinaire;
  • Curiosité démontrée dans les nouvelles technologies;
  • Fortes aptitudes démontrées en leadership d’équipe et de projet;
  • Capacité à mobiliser et à mentorer;
  • Grande capacité d’analyse, de synthèse et grande facilité à communiquer ses idées;
  • Excellent sens critique d’un produit fini;
  • Capacité de remise en question;
  • Diplomatie, patience, débrouillardise, organisation et rigueur.

raw.excerpt: At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.
raw.description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency. By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.

Build products customers value. Turn insights into action. Drive ideas from opportunity to impact.

At PDI Technologies, we build technology that helps businesses operate more efficiently, make smarter decisions, and deliver better experiences for their customers. We’re looking for a Product Manager who is curious, customer-focused, and energized by turning real-world problems into meaningful product solutions.

In this role, you’ll own a product or key product area, working closely with customers, Engineering, UX, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and other stakeholders to identify opportunities, set priorities, and bring solutions to market.

This is a great opportunity for a Product Manager who has built a solid foundation in product management and is ready to take greater ownership of product strategy, roadmap decisions, and business outcomes.

What you'll do

    • Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for an assigned product or product area.

    • Develop a deep understanding of customers, users, business needs, and market trends.

    • Translate customer problems and business opportunities into clear product requirements and outcomes.

    • Partner closely with Engineering and UX throughout discovery, development, testing, launch, and iteration.

    • Prioritize features and initiatives by balancing customer value, business impact, technical considerations, effort, and risk.

    • Gather and synthesize feedback from customers, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and other stakeholders.

    • Use product analytics, customer insights, and market data to evaluate performance and guide decisions.

    • Define success measures and monitor product adoption, utilization, customer experience, and business impact.

    • Partner with go-to-market teams to support product launches, positioning, enablement, and adoption.

    • Communicate roadmap priorities, product decisions, progress, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.

    • Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve the product and customer experience.

    • Use AI-enabled tools to improve product discovery, research, requirements development, analysis, and day-to-day product management.

    • Continuously learn, test assumptions, and adjust priorities based on results.

What we're looking for

    • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

    • 3–5+ years of product management, product ownership, business analysis, or related technology experience, with direct product management experience preferred.

    • Experience working with software or technology products through multiple stages of the product lifecycle.

    • Working knowledge of Agile product development practices and the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

    • Experience developing product requirements, user stories, roadmaps, and prioritization recommendations.

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn data and customer insights into product decisions.

    • Ability to understand technical concepts and effectively partner with Engineering teams.

    • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between technical, customer, and business audiences.

    • Experience collaborating across Engineering, UX, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, or similar functions.

    • Comfort working through ambiguity, balancing competing priorities, and making informed trade-offs.

    • Customer-focused mindset with genuine curiosity about how people use products and where their biggest challenges lie.

    • Experience with product and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Figma, Miro, or similar platforms.

    • Familiarity with AI-enabled tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

    • Experience with SaaS, cloud-based, enterprise software, payments, retail technology, data, or platform products.

    • Experience conducting customer discovery, competitive analysis, or market research.

    • Experience using product analytics to measure adoption and inform roadmap decisions.

    • Exposure to APIs, integrations, data platforms, or other technical product concepts.

    • Experience participating in product launches and go-to-market activities

What Success looks like

    You’ll be successful in this role when you understand the customer problem behind the request, not just the requested feature. You’ll bring clarity to competing priorities, build strong partnerships across teams, use data and customer insight to make thoughtful decisions, and consistently move products from idea to measurable customer and business value.
PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

About the job

Our Client, an international e-commerce company with a strong presence in the USA, is looking for a highly skilled and experienced professional to fill an immediate opening for Amazon PPC Manager for a full-time remote job.

As the Amazon PPC Manager, you will be responsible for managing the company's advertising efforts on Amazon, setting performance goals, elaborating PPC strategies, and ensuring the successful execution of Amazon PPC campaigns to drive sales and maximize profitability.

If you have a strong background in Amazon PPC advertising, exceptional leadership skills, and a passion for driving success in the E-commerce industry, we would love to hear from you.

About the Company:

It is a fast-growing small company that manages Amazon accounts and runs its own brand, offering eco-friendly products. The team works fully remotely, allowing for flexibility and efficiency while maintaining strong collaboration.

The company operates in an international and rapidly evolving market, providing a dynamic work environment. It encourages creativity and initiative, giving team members the opportunity to bring new ideas to life and make a real impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive Amazon PPC strategies across the companys brands, to increase visibility, drive sales, and achieve KPIs.
  • Conduct thorough keyword research and analysis to identify high-performing keywords and optimize campaigns for maximum ROI.
  • Monitor and optimize PPC campaigns, including bid management, budget allocation, A/B testing, and performance tracking to achieve optimal results.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Marketing and Product Development, to align PPC strategies with overall business goals and initiatives.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest trends, tools, and best practices in Amazon PPC advertising, sharing knowledge and implementing innovative strategies within the team.
  • Analyze data and generate actionable insights to improve campaign performance, conversion rates, and customer acquisition.
  • Prepare regular performance reports, highlighting key metrics, campaign results, and recommendations for further optimization.
  • Ensure compliance with Amazon's advertising policies and guidelines, staying informed about any changes or updates in the platform.

Qualification requirements:

  • Minimum 2 years of proven experience in Amazon PPC advertising.
  • In-depth knowledge of Amazon PPC campaign management, including campaign types, targeting options, bid management, and keyword optimization.
  • A proven track record of successfully managing PPC month budgets over $50k and delivering strong ROI.
  • Expertise in using the Amazon Advertising platform, analytics tools, and data analysis techniques to measure and improve campaign performance.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to extract actionable insights from complex datasets.
  • Strong understanding of keyword research, competitive analysis, and audience targeting in the context of Amazon PPC advertising.
  • Advanced skills in using Google Sheets or similar tools for data analysis and reporting.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and result-oriented, with a passion for continuous learning and keeping up-to-date with industry trends.

Working Hours

The working hours are based on GMT+2 time, but the company is not strict about them. They prioritize task completion over simply clocking in hours. Their approach is flexible, allowing team members to manage their time effectively while ensuring the work gets done.

Tracking & Tools

For advertising, the company uses:

  • Data Rova
  • Scale Insight
  • Helium 10

For communication and task management, the company uses:

  • Slack
  • ClickUp

Benefits:

  • Work for a market-proven, fast-growing company.
  • Competitive salary and bonus opportunities.
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment.
  • Opportunity to be part of something bigger, with autonomy over your work.
  • Fully remote work with flexible hours (work from whatever place).

The Business Operations Manager will provide comprehensive administrative, operational, and financial support to the STINGRAI Program Manager and cross-functional teams. This role manages day‑to‑day business processes, coordinates project and resource activities, oversees financial reporting and subcontractor management, and serves as a key liaison with internal departments including accounting, legal, HR, and the Program Support Office (PSO). The manager will drive standardization across program processes, support onboarding and compliance for subcontractors, enhance STINGRAI portal functionality, and ensure effective communication and workflow across stakeholders. This position requires strong leadership, exceptional organizational skills, the ability to manage complex program operations, and a Top-Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Manage day-to-day internal business processes across functional departments.
  • Assist in project coordination, logistics, recruiting, and procurement of resources and management.
  • Serve as primary interface with corporate accounting, legal, and HR.
  • Oversee financials, RIPs, TARs, invoicing, subcontractor management, and the STINGRAI Portal.
  • Collaborate and coordinate across the task order with internal and external stakeholders, interface with and spearhead communications across multiple internal business areas to ensure pertinent stakeholder involvement.
  • Oversee all aspects of program administrative and financial management, with principal responsibilities including financial reporting and control, contract, subcontractor and security management, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), presentation templates, continuous improvement initiatives, and portal content.
  • Responsible for developing and disseminating templates to standardize administrative aspects of TDL set-up and execution.
  • Interface with the Program Support Office (PSO) to ensure subcontractors are provided STINGRAI specific onboarding training and support to ensure compliance with AAS policies and accuracy of RIPs, TARs, Trip Reports, and invoicing.
  • Act as Liaison for mission driven enhancements to STINGRAI portals and knowledge repositories to facilitate information sharing, deliverables tracking, and enhance workflow.
  • Manage the functional matrixed support, providing clear direction, oversight, and accountability in coordination with shared services leadership, escalating issues early and often.
  • Direct activities and manage performance of PSO matrixed personnel, ensuring quality and on-time delivery.

What We Are Looking For

  • 8 years relevant progressive experience with Bachelors in related field; 6 years relevant progressive experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 12 years relevant progressive experience.
  • At least 4 years’ experience associated with an AAS Defense multi-tenant government contact.
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with clients, stakeholders, and team members at all levels.
  • Exceptional organizational and time management abilities.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with a track record of managing risks and making timely, informed judgments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Clearance: Must possess a Secret Clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI.

Preferred: Bonus Points For...

  • PMP certification.
  • Experience supporting intelligence community or DoD programs beyond AAS environments.
  • Familiarity with financial management systems, government invoicing, and subcontractor oversight.
  • Experience developing or implementing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Proficiency with data analysis tools, dashboards, or workflow platforms (e.g., SharePoint, Power BI, portal management tools).
  • Demonstrated experience leading matrixed teams in a distributed or remote environment.
  • Prior experience supporting multi‑tenant or enterprise‑level technical programs.
  • Background in process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, etc.).
  • Experience coordinating with security offices or managing clearance workflows.
  • Strong understanding of government contracting, including FAR/DFARS principles.

title: Remote IOP Mental Health Therapist (SUD) – Flexible Schedule
description: Steadfast Health was founded to establish a new standard of substance use disorder (SUD) care.

raw.title: Remote IOP Mental Health Therapist (SUD) – Flexible Schedule
raw.excerpt: Steadfast Health was founded to establish a new standard of substance use disorder (SUD) care.
raw.description:
Steadfast Health was founded to establish a new standard of substance use disorder (SUD) care. Recognizing that traditional treatment methods often fall short of reaching patients when they’re most in need, Steadfast is relentlessly focused on making low-barrier, high quality care accessible to all. We know that the journey to recovery is unique for every individual, and our patient-centered approach ensures we meet patients where they are, providing evidence-based therapies with unwavering support in a compassionate environment that fosters healing and growth.

Schedule: This is a full-time, 40-hour per week, fully remote, W2 position. The schedule includes required evening coverage Monday through Thursday, 5:00–8:00 PM ET, with the remainder of the 25 hours worked during daytime business hours of Monday-Friday 9a-5p.

What a Role at Steadfast Gives You

  • Predictable income, every pay period: a fixed base salary plus a monthly performance incentive, not variable, per-session pay that swings with cancellations, no-shows, or slow weeks.
  • Protected non-billable time, built into your schedule: 10.5 hours per week of paid,protected time for documentation, supervision, case consultation, and lunch — all part of your paid day, not unpaid work you fit in around billable hours.
  • Manageable, capped caseloads: we cap caseload size to protect quality of care and your wellbeing, growth in your caseload is planned and supported, not something you're expected to sustain indefinitely to keep your income up.
  • Administrative burden handled for you: in-house billing, AI-assisted documentation support, and MA/LPN and Peer Recovery Specialist support mean your time goes to patients, not paperwork or chasing reimbursement.
  • Full benefits: medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) match, paid time off, and 100% employer-paid disability and life insurance

Why Steadfast

  • Healthcare Coverage: medical, dental & vision insurance, plus 100% employer-paid short- and long-term disability and life insurance.
  • 401(k) Match: up to 5% company match.
  • Time Off: 29 days off a year to start (PTO, floating holidays, paid volunteer days), increasing on your anniversary — plus 4 Re-Fuel Days annually for mental health, rest, or CEU activities.
  • Continuing Education: annual CEU stipend and ongoing paid training.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): free, confidential access to therapy, legal, financial, and wellness resources.
  • Protected Time: built into your day for recharging, clinical supervision, huddles, care planning, and admin work.
  • Clinical Support: MA/LPN and Peer Recovery Specialist support, a collaborative care model with physician backup, and manageable panel sizes.
  • Additional perks: SoFi student loan interest rate discount, Rightway Health Concierge, a year of free pet telehealth through Pawp, and Perkspot discount marketplace.
  • Soulside AI documentation support: because your energy belongs with patients, not paperwork.

We believe lived experience with recovery is a strength, not a barrier — many of our team bring personal or family experience with addiction and recovery, and we welcome candidates in recovery to apply. This is also a ground-floor opportunity to help shape how we grow in the Raleigh market.

Key Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

  • Provide individual and group therapy sessions for patients with substance use disorders, via telehealth, embodying the Steadfast patient-first ethos.
  • Conduct comprehensive biopsychosocial assessments and develop individualized treatment plans, modeling a non-paternalistic and destigmatizing approach to patient care.
  • Utilize evidence-based therapeutic modalities, such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Motivational Interviewing (MI), and Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), to support patient recovery.
  • Collaborate with all clinic-level team members to formulate and execute patient care plans, including Advanced Practice Providers, Medical Assistants, and Peer Recovery Specialists, ensuring integrated treatment approaches.
  • Support patients in crisis intervention situations and coordinate higher levels of care when necessary.
  • Maintain thorough and timely documentation in compliance with state, federal, and organizational guidelines.
  • Pioneer innovative ways of improving access and overall care for disadvantaged, marginalized populations.
  • Champion the company’s mission by modeling compassion and fostering trust and strong relationships with patients and communities.
  • Educate patients and families on SUD, co-occurring disorders, and available resources to support sustained recovery and overall health.
  • Participate in regular case consultations, team meetings, and continuing education to stay current with best practices in SUD treatment.

Qualifications

  • Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor (LPCC)or LISW, IMFT in Ohio.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience providing therapy to individuals with substance use disorders.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience providing therapy in an IOP, PHP, or comparable treatment setting.
  • Certification in addiction counseling is a plus.
  • Experience with telehealth platforms and virtual care delivery is a plus.
  • Strong knowledge of SUD diagnoses, medications, and treatment modalities.
  • Ability to effectively interact with diverse staff, patients, and community members.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, a flexible, can-do mentality, and a commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
  • Passionate about Steadfast Health’s mission to provide low-barrier, non-punitive, harm-reductionist SUD care.

Physical Requirements
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position.Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods during patient sessions and team meetings.
  • Frequent use of hands for typing, writing, and handling clinical documentation.
  • Ability to quickly respond to emergencies, including assisting patients in distress or crisis situations.
  • Visual and auditory acuity to assess patient needs, read documentation, and communicate effectively.
  • Potential exposure to high-stress situations requiring emotional resilience and de-escalation skills.

Investors & Partners

Steadfast Health is proudly funded by Google Ventures (GV) and launched out of Triple Aim Partners. Since 2019, Triple Aim Partners (TAP) has partnered with entrepreneurs across the healthcare ecosystem to build transformative organizations, all with the mission of achieving the Triple Aim (better patient experience, better population health, and lower healthcare costs for all). TAP emphasizes the importance of creating strong, front-line focused company cultures that enable high-quality patient care.

description: The Director, Business and Process Optimization serves as a key member of the leadership team, providing strategic leadership in the direction and execution of the operations and resourcing for the department in a complex cross-functional environment to develop and execute strategies that ensure continuous process improvement and optimize organizational performance, processes, and associated systems, training and communications in order to achieve business goals and objectives.

raw.excerpt: The Director, Business and Process Optimization serves as a key member of the leadership team, providing strategic leadership in the direction and execution of the operations and resourcing for the department in a complex cross-functional environment to develop and execute strategies that ensure continuous process improvement and optimize organizational performance, processes, and associated systems, training and communications in order to achieve business goals and objectives.
raw.description:
The Director, Business and Process Optimization serves as a key member of the leadership team, providing strategic leadership in the direction and execution of the operations and resourcing for the department in a complex cross-functional environment to develop and execute strategies that ensure continuous process improvement and optimize organizational performance, processes, and associated systems, training and communications in order to achieve business goals and objectives.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provides management & strategic direction to the business operation/corporate function.
  • Participates with senior leadership in developing and authorizing the implementation of strategic business plans.
  • Oversees a portfolio of cross-functional activities, projects and initiatives delivering strategic insights, analyses and recommendations to drive continuous process improvement and assess compliance with cross-functional processes and associated systems/applications, training and communications.
  • Serves as business lead for large, complex, cross-functional process improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborates, innovates and consults with multiple stakeholders, peers and leaders to drive strategy, execution and communications planning to achieve continuous process improvement and departmental and organizational business imperatives, goals and objectives
  • Oversees initiatives to develop, optimize, improve and assess compliance with cross functional processes and associated systems/applications, training and communications.
  • Provides administrative oversight of the department, including staffing, budgeting, scheduling and long term planning. Provides strategic direction to staff through line management of a team. Accountable for effective recruitment, induction, talent development and retention of staff. Provides ongoing coaching and feedback including formal performance appraisals, development plans and career coaching.
  • Develops and implements business plans, forecasting and proactively supports and drives process and systems optimization activities.
  • May provide oversight and/or responses for client or internal process audits on processes, systems, or procedures and/or CAPAs.
  • Cultivates an environment of continuous improvement
  • Acts as an internal transformation consultant in overseeing M&A integration activities
  • Life science graduate, pharmacy, nursing, other healthcare related qualification or experience in pharmacovigilance
  • Extensive pharmacovigilance experience with experience of process improvement, safety applications and systems including demonstrated line management experience
  • Extensive leadership experience in PV from a service provider environment
  • Experience optimizing processes and managing through to implementation
  • Outstanding leadership and management skills
  • Advanced skill in process development and improvement, especially as it applies to clinical and post-marketing PV
  • Excellent project management skills
  • Certification in process improvement methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma is a plus
  • Superior attention to detail, investigative and analytical skills
  • Outstanding interpersonal, negotiation and problem solving skills
  • Superior computer skills, to include an effective understanding of clinical management and pharmacovigilance technology and systems
  • Expert understanding of the practices, processes and requirements of clinical trials, to include regulatory guidelines and directives
  • Superior oral and written communication skills including the ability to communicate in English, both orally and in writing
  • Capable of directing and promoting teamwork in a multidisciplinary and/or multi-cultural team setting
  • Capable of driving innovation in developing new ideas related to process improvements
  • Outstanding organizational, judgment, analytical, decision making and interpersonal skills to manage complex projects in parallel and manage rapidly changing priorities

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.

  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.

  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.

  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

At PrimeVigilance, patient safety is not one part of the job. It is why we exist.

We are a global pharmacovigilance specialist. Our teams help clients navigate complex regulations while keeping patient safety at the center of every decision, from early development through to post-marketing surveillance. Increasingly, the value we create is not only in processing safety data but in interpreting it: spotting the signal that matters early and turning it into insight our clients can act on.

That work takes curious minds, problem-solvers and experts who care about getting it right. It also takes a culture worth staying for. Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.

If you want a role with real purpose, global reach and the chance to keep growing while you help protect patients, you will feel at home here. We would love to hear from you.

Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

Heart Failure

Leading an active lifestyle is important to the many people we serve. In Abbott’s Heart Failure division, we’re advancing the treatment of heart and vascular disease through breakthrough medical technologies in electrophysiology and heart failure, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

What You’ll Work On

- Key point of contact for clinical issues for assigned territory customers.

- Training and educating customers on Abbott products per the approved educational materials and IFU's.

- Heartline and Travel Call responsibility.

- Attending implants to provide clinical support according to approved educational materials.

- Strategic planning and execution to improve clinical outcomes and business objectives within territory.

- Effective and timely management of territory clinical issues, and process related issues, including: monthly reports, Concur expense reporting, SFA input, and PEC reporting.

- Effective communication and collaboration with territory team, clinical team, training and education, marketing, technical support and management teams.

- Communicate regularly with Clinical Manager.

- Awareness of and adherence to Advamed guidelines.

- Active continuing education to stay current on the clinical issues impacting MCS.

- Designs, develops and implements quality educational programs.

- Actively participates in the communication of concepts and ideas designed to benefit customer support and educational efforts.

- Tracks industry trends to alert marketing to new product direction.

- Provides input into the strategic and tactical planning process.

- Coordinates and assists with the training of all centers in an assigned geographical region.

- Maintains contact with customers in order to assess clinical and educational needs.

- Evaluates customer needs and recommends appropriate product modifications.

- Creates, maintains, and updates educational materials.

- Assists in the promotion of Abbott's product to prospective clients in cooperation with the sales team.

- Evaluates product viability and planned product improvements and modifications.

- Completes clinical reports as requested by management, and completes all additional documentation requested by management in a timely basis.

- Protects and acts responsibly toward all company equipment and confidential information.

- Provides support at Tradeshows as requested by management.

Required Qualifications

- Undergraduate Degree in Nursing or some other medical discipline. Graduate Degree desirable.

- 3-5 years heart failure experience or equivalent preferred.

- Background in Nursing, Circulatory Support or Cardiology.

Preferred Qualifications

- Nursing (ICU or CCU), clinical publications, and group presentations desirable.

- Computer literacy.

- Highly motivated, have excellent written and verbal communications skills, great desire to help others, composed under stress and well organized.

title: Principal Experience Designer - Visual Design & Design Systems
description: Workiva is looking for a Principal Experience Designer to shape the visual future of Unify, our enterprise design system.

raw.title: Principal Experience Designer - Visual Design & Design Systems
raw.excerpt: Workiva is looking for a Principal Experience Designer to shape the visual future of Unify, our enterprise design system.
raw.description:
Workiva is looking for a Principal Experience Designer to shape the visual future of Unify, our enterprise design system. Unify powers the components, patterns, templates, accessibility standards, and shared experiences used across Workiva’s B2B platform.


This is a dual-focus principal role. Roughly 60–70% of your time will be spent leading Unify’s visual design direction: evolving its visual language, shaping token architecture, and creating the reference designs and guidance that help teams build consistently. The remaining 30–40% will focus on high-visibility visual work for major conferences, marketing partnerships, and executive audiences. That work is not separate from the system, it’s part of the broader ecosystem of design in which Unify lives.


You will bring exceptional visual craft, strong systems thinking, and a practical point of view on how design systems need to evolve for AI-assisted design and prototyping.

What you’ll do

  • Define and evolve Unify’s visual language across typography, color, spacing, iconography, motion, and brand expression.
  • Partner with the components sub-team and the patterns and templates sub-team to ensure visual design is applied consistently and intentionally across every asset.
  • Partner with product design, product mgmt and engineering teams to ensure product experience decisions translate faithfully from system to production.
  • Maintain a scalable, semantic token architecture that supports consistent experiences across products and over time.
  • Create and maintain a library of reference designs, full-screen examples that demonstrate how Unify should be applied in real product experiences.
  • Own visual usage guidance and documentation that make intended use, constraints, and quality standards clear for designers, engineers, and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Establish ongoing evaluation of AI-generated designs and prototypes, using what you learn to strengthen tokens, examples, and guidance before inconsistencies reach product teams.
  • Lead visual design for select high-stakes moments, including major conferences, executive presentations, product vision work, and marketing partnerships.
  • Coach designers and influence cross-functional partners through high-quality feedback, clear principles, and strong visual storytelling.

What you’ll need

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in product design, visual design, UX, or related fields, including significant work on platform or enterprise products.
  • Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or a related field (or 8 years of experience and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 6 years of experience).

Preferred Qualifications

  • A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft and the ability to translate a visual point of view into scalable product systems.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping workflows, with a clear perspective on their opportunities and limitations.
  • Experience defining or evolving a design system’s visual language, including tokens, components, patterns, and documentation.
  • Strong ability to create compelling product narratives for senior leaders and high-visibility audiences.
  • Experience partnering closely with engineers and working through the tradeoffs between design intent, system health, and implementation.
  • A track record of influencing and coaching teams without relying on formal authority.
  • Experience building reference sites, design-system documentation, or machine-readable design guidance.
  • Experience with semantic or multi-tier token systems, motion design, presentation design, or event experiences.
  • Background in front-end development, developer tools, cross-platform systems, or highly regulated industries.

Travel Requirements & Working Conditions

  • Up to 20-25% travel required to meet with teams, partners, and customers
  • Reliable internet connection required for remote or hybrid work environments

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ Salary range in the US: $190,000.00 - $315,000.00

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Why Join Workiva

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

raw.excerpt: Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era.
raw.description:
Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

At Cribl, we're transforming from a flagship-product company into a multi-product powerhouse - and every non-routine business event, whether an acquisition, a product launch, or a go-to-market shift, adds complexity our data, definitions, and reporting weren't built to handle. As the Analytics Business Partner, you're the person who closes that gap - translating a new product or customer into our existing data, systems and reporting: how it connects to what we already have, how value is attributed, how we define and track it going forward. Reporting to the VP of Data & Analytics — part of Cribl's broader Business Operations organization alongside Strategy & Operations and Business Effectiveness — you'll operate horizontally across the business rather than embedding in a single function.

This is a high-impact role for a strategist who thrives on ambiguity and builds order from chaos. If you are eager to contribute to a company poised for generational success, we want to hear from you.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Diagnose and Drive the Solution. When a non-routine business event doesn't fit with how we currently track or report on the business, define the solution. Whether a system change, a new process or policy, or a different data model, serve as the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for working with the necessary x-functional teams to get it delivered
  • M&A Integration. When we acquire a company, own and drive how its products and customers fit into our existing reporting and data models, ensuring we can capture the impact of the acquisition post deal close
  • New Product Launch. When we launch a new product, understand how Product defines its success metrics, and make sure our models, definitions, and reporting can track against those metrics post launch
  • Keep Execution Moving. When a change spans across the Data and Analytics team (Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, Data Governance), sequence who does what first, own the handoffs between them, catch duplication or gaps before they cost the team time, and push the pace when the event demands it
  • Stand Up the Business Intelligence Council. Establish and run the forum where cross-functional leaders align on key measures, attributes, and hierarchy definitions, and on prioritization across competing data and analytics efforts — and drive it to actual resolution, rather than let it stall as a standing meeting.
  • Know The Business. Maintain a working picture of how GTM, Finance, Product, and other functions operate, knowing who to engage so a project doesn’t start or drift, without the right people engaged. For example, understanding how Product Marketing is positioning a new feature, how it needs to be represented across our applications in partnership with IT, and how Finance will measure its impact, before scoping the data work for it.
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours

If You've Got It - We Want It

  • 8+ years in management consulting, in-house strategy, business operations, or business analytics, with a track record of operating in unfamiliar functions and reframing ambiguously-posed questions
  • Fluency across GTM, Finance, Product, and other functions - enough to know that 'customer' may mean something different to Sales than it does to Finance, and to reconcile the difference rather than pick a side
  • You can join multiple tables, write a CTE, and get the aggregation grain right - enough to answer your own question - though hands-on query and dashboard work won't be your primary responsibility in this role
  • Given a reporting issue, you know not to default to a “data-only” answer - you can tell whether the real problem is a system that isn't capturing the right data, a process nobody owns, or a data model that no longer matches the business
  • Ability to flex your communication style as needed - equally fluent giving execs the top-line takeaway and working through the nuances with the operational teams to drive a solution
  • First hand experience ensuring a business’s data and reporting keep up following an acquisition or new product launch - designing and driving the solution so the business doesn’t lose visibility into itself
  • Bonus: experience inside a post-close M&A integration, a new product introduction, or a go-to-market model change
  • Bonus: experience in late-stage B2B SaaS startups (i.e., Series E+) and / or early public B2B SaaS companies (e.g., 3-5k employees)

The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

Base Salary Range
$190,000—$255,000 USD

Bring Your Whole Self
Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. raw.excerpt: The Role:The Director, License Assurance will lead Apryse's global license audit function into a proactive, cross-product compliance program.
raw.description:
The Role:

The Director, License Assurance will lead Apryse's global license audit function into a proactive, cross-product compliance program. This role will report to the Vice President of License Management and manage the team, operating model, audit processes, system requirements, and performance accountability, with a focus on establishing a scalable, data-driven program that systematically covers Apryse's eligible existing-customer base and delivers measurable business outcomes.

The Director will oversee reviews of customer software usage against contractual entitlements, including licensed volume commitments, permitted use cases, deployment and redistribution rights, royalty obligations, and reporting requirements. The team will document findings and coordinate with the appropriate stakeholders to resolve identified licensing gaps.

This role will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Sales Operations, Business Systems, Finance, Legal, Product, and data teams to develop clear processes, reliable systems and reporting, and effective handoffs. The Director will leverage Salesforce, Apryse’ AI environment and related systems to serve as reliable records for audit activity, usage data, entitlement validation, findings, outcomes, and reporting.

The right candidate is a strategic, hands-on leader who has led a software license audit, license assurance, or software compliance function and has experience building or significantly improving audit operations. They should be comfortable leading global teams, establishing performance expectations, and working directly with customers and internal stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop the global License Assurance team, including capacity and production planning, team assignments, coaching, hiring, onboarding, performance management, and quality standards. Align auditor capacity and production targets with coverage priorities and expected pipeline and bookings contribution.
  • Own the proactive audit program and its governance, including risk-based customer coverage and prioritization based on licensing signals, nominations, and potential exposure, as well as audit methodology, performance expectations, and success measures.
  • Define and improve the end-to-end audit lifecycle from intake and prioritization through customer engagement, entitlement validation, findings, handoff, escalation, and closure.
  • Establish standards for auditing customer software usage against contractual entitlements, including usage volumes, permitted uses, deployment and redistribution rights, royalty obligations, and current or historical licensing terms. Ensure the team can validate usage of embedded software where direct technical visibility may be limited.
  • Own business requirements for Salesforce and related audit systems, working with Business Systems, Sales Operations, and other technical teams to ensure reliable audit data, workflows, controls, and reporting and to address system gaps, data issues, and bottlenecks.
  • Maintain reporting and accountability for program performance, including capacity, throughput, aging, quality, pipeline creation, bookings contribution, and key risks, and provide clear updates to leadership on performance, staffing, process and system needs, and business impact.
  • Ensure audit findings and customer communications are accurate, professional, and documented, with clear coordination and handoffs across Sales, Customer Success, Sales Operations, Finance, Legal, Product, and other stakeholders for commercial resolution, financial reporting, contract questions, and escalations.
  • Establish a consistent operating cadence to review team productivity, audit progress and aging, quality, commercial handoffs, data completeness, reporting accuracy, and downstream business impact.
  • Extend the audit model across product lines and acquired products, including royalty workflows, customer-submitted usage data, telemetry, and other sources that can help identify where an audit is needed.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree required, an advanced degree or relevant certification is a plus.
  • 10+ years of experience working in software and technology with progressing experience involving license audit/assurance, IP/licensing operations, or a closely related audit or compliance function
  • 5+ years in a management role
  • Strong understanding of software licensing and compliance
  • Experience with end-to-end audit operations
  • Strong Salesforce or similar CRM/workflow experience
  • Strong communication skills, proven experience working cross functionally and demonstrated strong customer relations experience
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills
  • Strong leadership, organization, problem-solving, and decision-making skills

Compensation Philosophy

The compensation for this position is commensurate upon experience, and the range listed reflects total compensation or on target earnings. The top end of the range is reserved for candidates with extensive experience and a profile that strongly aligns with the senior expectations of this role.

Location Eligibility

This is a remote position within the United States. We aim to hire in our primary hub locations first — Boston, MA; Denver, CO; and Charlotte, NC — but are also open to candidates who reside in the following states: Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, and Virginia.

Candidates must reside in one of these states to be considered for this opportunity.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications.
  • A comprehensive extended benefits package including health, dental and vision for you and your family, with company paid offerings.
  • An uncapped commissions structure.
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) is offered to support the ability to rest and recharge.
  • A great team environment and resources, supporting you to do the best work of your life and providing unlimited career growth potential.
  • Highly autonomous and entrepreneurial environment.
  • Annual recurring WFH allowance for you to purchase items you need for your home office.
  • Ongoing support for learning development so you can master your craft.
  • Work with the hardware you're most comfortable with (Windows or Mac).
  • Diverse and inclusive workplace where we all learn from each other.
Company Description

As the industry-leading provider of document software development (SDK) technology powering everything from traditional desktop software to innovative web and mobile applications, at Apryse we are committed to delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that empower our clients to achieve their goals. With a broad international portfolio of combined companies, products, and leading technologies, we are actively changing the way the world works with documents to make work better and life simpler.

Customers like IBM, Autodesk, DocuSign, Boeing, Microsoft (and many more!) come to us to realize their web and mobile strategies for document management, editing, and collaboration as the #1-ranked commercial document SDK of choice for companies worldwide. As a result, you can find our document technology in thousands of solutions, including those of household names, used by millions across virtually every industry. Our XODO app alone has 25M unique installs -- and counting -- and the highest ratings among PDF productivity apps on the largest online app marketplaces.

Ready to join our team?

If you are interested in helping Apryse deliver on its commitments and taking your career to the next level, we invite you to apply online now. Additionally, we view the above section as a guide, not a checklist. We welcome diverse and non-traditional backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you do not have every requirement listed.

We are committed to a work environment that is inclusive to all and free of discrimination.
