raw.excerpt: Max Retail is a cutting-edge technology platform enabling independent retailers and brands to sell their excess inventory online effortlessly.
raw.description:
Max Retail is a cutting-edge technology platform enabling independent retailers and brands to sell their excess inventory online effortlessly. Our mission is to become the largest supply chain that holds no inventory, providing a seamless connection between supply and global demand. We empower our partners with the tools they need to thrive in an increasingly competitive market.

MaxRetail is a two-sided marketplace that helps independent retailers turn overstock inventory into revenue. We are hiring a Director of Sales to own the retailer acquisition engine: keep our current motion running, hit closing and conversion targets, and scale the team, playbooks and automation behind it.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will coach reps on calls, run role plays, staff tradeshow booths, and own the forecast. You will also partner with RevOps and Product to automate what can be automated and remove the bottlenecks that slow new retailer growth.

MaxRetail is moving from a sales led to a product led growth model. You will lead that shift for the sales team: keep closing today while building the self-serve paths, automation and handoffs that let the product acquire and convert more retailers on its own. Your team's focus will move toward the deals and moments where a human adds the most value.

What You'll Do:

Revenue and closing

  • Keep the current sales motion running without disruption while you improve it.

  • Drive strong, consistent close rates on our current motion.

  • Improve SQL to close conversion across inbound and outbound.

  • Own sales metrics, reporting and forecasting, with a forecast leadership can plan against.

  • Know the key business inputs that drive sales (lead volume, lead source mix, speed to lead, demo held rate, onboarding completion) and actively influence them.

Outbound team performance

  • Manage outbound SDRs to consistent, high-quality demo volume.

  • Manage full cycle closers to clear demo and closing goals.

  • Hold in-house and outsourced outbound partners to the same performance standards.

Coaching and enablement

  • Review call recordings with RevOps and turn findings into better workflows and follow up templates.

  • Run regular role plays on objection handling based on the sales playbook.

  • Join live calls with reps to help close deals and model what good looks like.

  • Scale our playbooks so new reps ramp faster and results do not depend on a few top performers.

  • Recruit, hire and train new cohorts and get them producing quickly.

Incentives and motivation

  • Design spiff and incentive plans that align with business goals and stay within budget.

  • Motivate the team to hit or exceed goals.

  • Build a supportive, uplifting, growth mindset culture where reps want to stay and improve.

Automation and scale

  • Automate cold outbound and inbound motions where it improves speed or consistency.

  • Use AI to increase team efficiency and throughput.

  • Partner with Product and RevOps to remove self serve bottlenecks and scale new seller counts.

  • Identify gaps in seller onboarding that cause new seller churn and drive the fixes.

Tradeshows

  • Own tradeshow execution end to end: activation, staffing and the onsite experience.

  • Ensure the team collects leads and gives demos on site.

  • Own conversion of tradeshow leads after the show.

First 90 days

  1. Days 1 to 30: learn the motion, sit in on calls, audit the pipeline, metrics and current playbook.

  2. Days 31 to 60: launch a weekly call review and role play cadence, propose a spiff plan, and present a forecast.

  3. Days 61 to 90: ship the first automation or AI workflow, name the top onboarding gaps behind new seller churn, and set a hiring plan for the next cohort.

Who You Are:

Required

  • 10+ years in sales, including 3+ years in sales management, managing a team of SDRs and closers to quota.

  • Proven record at a technology company, ideally one that grew from startup to scale while you were there.

  • Experience building and managing a remote sales team and the culture that keeps it accountable and connected

  • Owned the implementation of an AI or automation tool for a sales team, including process redesign, training, and driving adoption until it became part of the daily workflow.

  • A proven closer who can jump on live calls with reps and close the deal, building the team's trust by leading from the front.

  • A record of hitting conversion and activity targets in a high volume, transactional or SMB motion.

  • Experience designing compensation, spiff or incentive plans within a budget.

  • Strong forecasting and reporting skills; comfortable working in HubSpot or a similar CRM.

  • Experience hiring and ramping new reps in cohorts on a short timeline.

  • A coaching style built on call review and role play.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling to independent retailers or in a marketplace business.

  • Experience managing outsourced outbound or lead gen partners.

  • Tradeshow sales experience, from booth staffing to post-show follow up.

We want a leader who raises the bar and lifts people up at the same time.

Title: Salesforce Test Engineer
Location: Remote

About VivSoft:
At VivSoft, we aim to solve complex federal problems using emerging and open technologies in a collaborative and rewarding environment. VivSoft is a diverse team of strategists, engineers, designers, and creators experienced in building high-performance effective software, with impactful organizational design and organizational dynamics for software delivery. We build secure Software Factories based on DoD reference designs and NIST Frameworks for Cloud and DevSecOps. These factories deliver AI/ML Applications, Data Science Platforms, Blockchain and Microservices for DoD, Healthcare and Civilian Agencies.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Salesforce QA/Test Engineer with strong platform-specific expertise and a solid understanding of DoD security compliance requirements. This role focuses on validating secure, scalable Salesforce solutions through comprehensive testing strategies, supporting ATO readiness, and ensuring alignment with federal standards.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and execute functional, integration, and security-focused test strategies for Salesforce implementations.
  • Develop and maintain detailed acceptance test cases aligned with business and technical requirements.
  • Validate CI/CD processes, including Flosum pipeline gates, to ensure quality and compliance.
  • Perform baseline security health checks and document findings to support ATO artifact development.
  • Conduct testing across Apex, Salesforce Flows, permission sets, profiles, and rules engines.
  • Execute integration testing for REST/API-based services and external system interactions.
  • Validate Salesforce Shield configurations, encryption mechanisms, and data protection controls.
  • Perform offline/mobile testing and ensure compliance with Section 508 accessibility standards.
  • Identify, track, and manage defects, particularly those related to security and compliance.
  • Collaborate with engineering and architecture teams to ensure test coverage aligns with system design and security requirements.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related STEM field.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce platform testing, including Apex and LWC/UI automation.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security model, including roles, profiles, and permission sets.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools, specifically Flosum, and automated testing frameworks.
  • Knowledge of DoD security compliance frameworks and their application in testing (e.g., ATO processes, security validation).
  • Experience with integration testing, including REST APIs and middleware interactions.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (Section 508) and security health check processes.
  • Salesforce certifications:
    • Salesforce Platform Developer I
    • Salesforce Administrator
    • Salesforce Platform App Builder (or equivalent)
  • Eligibility to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance.

The Summer 2027 Enterprise Risk Strategy Undergraduate Internship provides students with an opportunity to gain practical, hands-on experience supporting enterprise risk management, governance, compliance, and strategic planning initiatives across Highmark Health. This internship is designed to develop the next generation of business professionals by providing direct exposure to how organizations identify, assess, monitor, and manage risks while advancing strategic business objectives in a complex healthcare environment.


As a member of the Enterprise Risk Strategy team, the intern will work alongside risk professionals and business leaders to support activities that strengthen the organization's enterprise risk management framework and governance processes. Participants will gain valuable insight into the interconnected areas of enterprise risk management, healthcare operations, regulatory compliance, corporate governance, strategic planning, and organizational resilience.


The program provides hands-on training and exposure to a variety of career opportunities within Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), Governance, Compliance, Business Strategy, Healthcare Operations, Information Security, and Risk Analytics. Interns will contribute to meaningful projects focused on risk reporting, research and analysis, governance activities, risk assessments, and strategic initiatives that help support organizational decision-making and risk oversight.


Typical responsibilities include supporting enterprise risk reporting and documentation, researching emerging risks and industry trends, maintaining risk-related data and reporting tools, assisting with risk assessments and risk taxonomy development, preparing presentations and executive-facing materials, and participating in strategic projects across Enterprise Risk & Governance. Through mentorship, collaboration, and project-based learning, interns will strengthen their analytical, research, communication, and business skills while developing a foundational understanding of enterprise risk management within the healthcare industry.

The SDM ensures alignment to the Radionix sales strategy by driving consistent execution, managing performance through defined KPIs, and maintaining visibility into pipeline, activity, and partner development across their region.

Territory Ownership (Direct Sales)

  • Drive revenue performance by identifying, developing, and closing new business opportunities across intrusion and access control solutions, while expanding share through cross-selling across the Radionix portfolio.
  • Maintain full ownership of pipeline, forecasting, and revenue attainment within the assigned territory.
  • Provide pre-sales technical support and solution development in partnership with the regional sales organization, including product education, proof of concepts, system design, and integration planning across Radionix and third-party platforms.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to customers, integrators, and consultants by supporting system specifications, delivering technical presentations, and influencing design decisions to drive future opportunities.

Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Litify is proud to be recognized as one of Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500’s fastest-growing private companies in America along with numerous awards for its unparalleled software. POSITION SUMMARY

The team member is responsible forassisting in managing outstanding company receivables and providing stellar customer service through all communications from submission of invoices through collection of payment.The collections specialist is also responsible for reporting updates to management on customer account status & outstanding issues.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Position:

Job Description:

Strong businesses are built on strong support teams. At Arrow, our Business Support professionals help drive operational excellence by connecting people, improving processes, and enabling collaboration across our global organization.


Whether you're supporting business operations, coordinating projects, or helping teams work more efficiently, you'll contribute to continuous improvement, deliver exceptional service, and help build a more agile, connected, and innovative business.


The Business Process Manager serves as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, IT teams, Salesforce developers, architects, and leadership. The position combines Product Ownership, Business Process Management, and Salesforce Administration to ensure business objectives are successfully translated into scalable platform solutions.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Operates with minimal supervision while managing competing priorities across strategic projects, enhancement requests, production support, and governance activities.

Product Owner

With the extended Business Team (Executive Sponsor, Managers & Super Users) ensure we deliver and sustain effective process consistency, excellence, and adoption to support Business strategies and goals. Promotes a process driven ethos and continuous improvement mindset

  • Lead requirements gathering, business process design, prioritization, and stakeholder alignment activities to ensure delivery of scalable solutions that support business objectives and operational KPIs.

  • Support UAT planning and execution.

What We're Looking For

  • Requires in-depth knowledge and experience of Product Ownership (Agile/Scrum & ECS business processes and applications)
  • Requires advanced knowledge and experience in Salesforce Administration
  • Leads requirements gathering, solution design discussions, UAT activities, release validations, and post-deployment support for medium to large-scale initiatives.
  • Evaluates and recommends configuration, automation, integration, and process improvement solutions while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, scalability, and business objectives.
  • Influences prioritization decisions across multiple stakeholder groups and manages dependencies between business, technical, and vendor teams.
  • Must be able to handle all technical support inquiries for Salesforce and adjacent Salesforce tools such as Outlook Add-ins, SalesLoft, and integrated systems such as Power BI and other Arrow Salesforce Orgs via SF-to-SF Connectors
  • Provide system administration support of internal and customer-facing Salesforce environment, especially related to customized applications, user permissions, security settings, custom objects, and workflow.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce automation capabilities, including Flow Builder, approval processes, and declarative automation best practices.
  • Strong Salesforce configuration and administration experience required. Working knowledge of Apex, Visualforce, Lightning components, and custom development methodologies is preferred.
  • Must be extremely proficient in SFDC data modeling for reports and dashboards.
  • Interact directly with partners, managers, and users as necessary to analyze user story objectives and capability requirements, including specifications for user interfaces, customized applications, and interactions with internal Salesforce instance (includes being proficient in detailed user story requirements gathering, documentation/write-ups, acceptance criteria, goals, and assumptions).
  • Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience
  • Demonstrated expertise in Salesforce administration, data modeling, automation, security, and platform configuration, with experience partnering with developers, architects, integration specialists, and business stakeholders to deliver enterprise-scale solutions.
  • 5+ years experience supporting Salesforce platforms.
  • 3+ years experience functioning as Product Owner, Business Analyst, or Business Process Manager.
  • Strong requirements gathering and documentation skills.
  • Experience supporting platform integrations.

The Skills That Will Help You Succeed Even More:

  • Salesforce AI Associate

    • User Stories

Experience / Education

  • Strong commercial acumen with ability to produce data‑driven territory strategies, forecasting models, and QBRs using CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), analytics, and Excel.

About Our Company:

Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, Cologix is a leading North America network-neutral interconnection and hyperscale edge data center company. Our platform gives customers access to 45+ digital edge and Scalelogix℠ hyperscale edge data centers in 13 markets across the United States and Canada along with a carrier-dense ecosystem of 710+ networks, 360+ cloud providers, 35+ onramps and seven Internet exchanges. We provide our nearly 2,000 customers with direct access to our local operations teams, resulting in strong partnerships enabled by exceptional operational support and unparalleled customer service. Backed by one of the largest North American infrastructure funds, Cologix's experienced leadership team, certified staff and commitment to ESG initiatives help form a culture that values our people, our environment and our clients.

About the Position

We are seeking an experienced and proactive HR Business Partner to support employees, managers, and business leaders across multiple locations throughout the United States and Canada.

This role combines hands-on HR support with business partnership, manager enablement, performance management, leadership development, leave administration, and organizational effectiveness. The ideal candidate possesses strong HR expertise, sound judgment, and the ability to build effective relationships while providing practical guidance and supporting organizational objectives.

What You Do Daily

    Manager Enablement & Leadership Development

  • Assist in the development and deliver manager training in collaboration with HR leadership to strengthen managerial skills and competencies.
  • Identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness and support managers in the consistent application of HR policies and procedures.

    • Leave Management & Employee Accommodations

  • Manage and administer employee leaves of absence across the US and Canada, including FMLA, state and provincial leave programs, disability-related absences, and other applicable leaves.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employees and managers regarding leave eligibility, documentation requirements, leave status, and return-to-work processes.
  • Coordinate workplace accommodation and return-to-work arrangements in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.
  • Maintain accurate leave records and employee status information in Dayforce, monitor leave timelines, and coordinate with Payroll and Total Rewards as needed.

    • Talent Management & Organizational Development

  • Partner with leadership to identify talent development needs, high-potential employees, and opportunities to improve organizational effectiveness.
  • Support talent reviews, succession planning, employee development, and retention initiatives in collaboration with HR leadership.
  • Evaluate employee exit feedback and turnover trends to identify retention risks and recommend improvements to the employee experience.

    • HR Projects, Analytics & Compliance

  • Support HR initiatives, including employee engagement surveys, policy development, organizational design, and process improvements.
  • Analyze workforce metrics, including turnover, retention, engagement, and performance trends, to identify opportunities and recommend improvements.
  • Support the development, implementation, and consistent application of HR policies and programs across the US and Canada.
  • Coordinate federal, state, provincial, and other applicable regulatory reporting requirements, collaborating with internal stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely submissions.
  • Monitor employment law and regulatory changes, provide compliance-related guidance to managers, and identify potential impacts on HR policies and practices.

    • Employee Relations

  • Assist with employee relations activities and recommend appropriate resolutions, escalating complex or sensitive matters as needed.
  • Promote a positive workplace culture through consistent application of HR policies, effective communication, and employee engagement.

    • Performance Management

  • Coordinate and administer performance management processes, ensuring consistent implementation across the organization.
  • Analyze performance trends and partner with leadership to address challenges, promote accountability, and support employee development.

What Makes You a Good Fit

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Minimum of 7+ years of progressive HR experience, with a strong background in manager development, performance management, and business partnering.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise and influence managers and business leaders while handling sensitive employee matters with discretion and sound judgment.
  • Experience supporting talent management, organizational development, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of employment laws and HR practices in the United States and Canada.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to interpret workforce data and recommend actionable solutions.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and balance day-to-day HR responsibilities with longer-term initiatives.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Dayforce or a comparable HRIS preferred.
  • SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, SPHR, or applicable Canadian HR designation preferred.
  • Conversational or fluent French language skills preferred; experience supporting geographically dispersed or multi-site operations is an asset.

raw.description:
About the role

The Workforce Manager leads end-to-end workforce strategy and operational execution for a dedicated, large-scale Rapid Data Center Deployment (RDD) program. Acting as the single point of contact for account-level resource planning, this role ensures field workforce capacity, specialized skill sets, and deployment readiness are tightly aligned with project timelines, deployment schedules, and customer SLAs. This position bridges strategy and execution—governing demand forecasting, resource allocation, and field readiness while serving as the primary escalation point for staffing constraints and workforce operational risks.

Location: Saline, MI

What you'll be doing

Capacity Planning & Forecasting

  • Partner with account leadership and project management to build robust demand models, translating project timelines and deployment schedules into precise headcount, skill, and location requirements.
  • Run scenario analyses to evaluate the workforce impact of scope changes, site delays, or accelerated timelines, establishing buffer strategies to mitigate risk without over-allocating budget.

Operational Execution & Deployment

  • Oversee day-to-day workforce allocation, ensuring field teams, sub-contractors, and technical specialists are fully vetted, badged, compliant, and deployed on schedule across customer sites.
  • Manage site-level shift schedules, travel logistics, and coverage rotations to minimize field burnout, control overtime expenses, and maintain continuous coverage on high-priority sites.
  • Serve as the primary onsite communication owner for workforce-related updates, including staffing levels, coverage risks, resource constraints, schedule impacts, and resolution plans.
  • Coordinate partner and resource onboarding readiness, including required documentation, system access, operational setup, and deployment readiness.

Governance & Risk Mitigation

  • Establish account-level WFM governance, actively monitoring staffing bottlenecks, credentialing delays, and labor risks.
  • Serve as a primary workforce liaison for union labor, partnering with union representatives, field leadership, and subcontractors to address workforce issues, escalations, and labor-related concerns.
  • Develop and drive corrective action plans and serve as the final escalation point for workforce issues.

Performance & Operational Reporting

  • Define, track, and report on core workforce metrics (e.g., resource utilization, schedule variance, deployment readiness, and forecast accuracy) to drive continuous operational improvement.
  • Conduct post-project WFM retrospective analyses to compare forecasted vs. actual labor utilization, pinpointing inefficiencies to continuously refine future account bidding and planning assumptions.

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Coordinate across internal operations, external staffing partners, vendor management, and field leaders to maintain an agile, audit-ready workforce across dynamic data center environments.
  • Coordinate workforce-related invoice and accounts payable activities with Finance and Professional Services, including validation of supporting workforce and timekeeping information, resolution of invoice discrepancies, and escalation of payment issues that could impact partner performance or resource continuity.

What you have

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Operations, Human Resource Management, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in workforce planning, resource management, project delivery, service delivery, field operations, or data center infrastructure environments.
  • Demonstrated experience managing large union or represented workforces, including direct experience partnering with union leadership and managing labor relations, workforce issues, and escalations required.
  • Experience supporting large-scale IT infrastructure, data center deployment, service center, or professional services delivery operations preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to model complex resource demand against volatile, fast-paced project schedules.
  • Skilled in navigating matrixed organizations, managing partner relationships, and briefing executive stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of workforce compliance, badging/site access protocols, and labor reporting frameworks.
  • Professional self-starter with strong business acumen and the ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Legally eligible to work in the United States.

What you can expect

There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. In addition to offering competitive compensation plans and long-term career opportunities, we provide an attractive mix of benefit plans to contribute to your good health, future financial security, and peace of mind.

About us

Computacenter is a leading independent technology partner, trusted by large corporate and public sector organizations. We help our world-renowned customers to source, transform, and manage their IT infrastructure to deliver digital transformation, enabling users and their business. We’re a public company quoted on the London FTSE 250 (CCC.L) and employ over 21,000 people worldwide. In the US, we support some of the country’s best-known businesses with regional hubs in San Francisco and Irvine, CA; Norcross, GA; Plano, TX; and New York City; and Integration Centers in Silicon Valley and Atlanta.

raw.title: Product Designer (US - Part-time, Contract)
raw.excerpt: Spate is a trend intelligence platform for consumer brands in beauty, wellness, and food and beverage.
raw.description:
Spate is a trend intelligence platform for consumer brands in beauty, wellness, and food and beverage. We analyze anonymous, aggregated public consumer data to spot emerging trends early and explain why they're growing, so brands can make product and marketing decisions with confidence.

Our founders, Yarden Horwitz and Olivier Zimmer, started Google's Trendspotting division and called trends like turmeric, cold brew, and face masks before they went mainstream. Spate is Y Combinator-backed, and more than 200 brands use it, including Sephora, L'Oréal Paris, Estée Lauder Companies, Unilever, P&G, and e.l.f. Our data regularly appears in The New York Times, WWD, British Vogue, and The Business of Fashion.

About the role

We're looking for a part-time contract product designer to shape Spate's core product: the dashboard where brand teams explore trends, build reports, and work with our AI assistant.

Our platform will change a lot over the next year or two as we rebuild around LLM-powered features. We already ship an AI Assistant, AI Reports (an LLM powered dashboard builder), and in-dashboard summaries and analysis. We need someone who can work out what those experiences should be, not just how they should look.

Our users are brand innovation teams, product marketers, social media teams, and agencies. Most aren't data analysts, so much of the job is turning dense trend data into something clear and actionable.

You'll join the Frontend & UX team, four people including you, and work closely with our frontend lead. The role is fully remote and part-time, about 20 hours a week. You’ll need to be based in US Central Time (UTC−6) or US Eastern Time (UTC-5). We require you to be available for core collaboration hours of 9:00 AM–12:00 PM Eastern.

This is a remote, Part-time contractor position.

What you'll own

The product, not just the screens. At Spate, product design and UI/UX design happen together. Features aren't fully defined and then handed to a designer. You'll help decide what we build and why, and stay involved from the first conversation to launch. You'll work with our frontend lead to choose the right deliverable for each problem: a written proposal, a user flow, a prototype, or a full Figma spec.

Finding problems worth solving. Find user pain points on your own, through customer calls, feedback, and usage data. Then take them from problem to proposal: frame the problem, explore options, and make the case for a direction. Leadership sets the overall direction and can help point you at problems, but you won't need our input to get started.

How our AI features work. Decide when something should be a chat, a report, or an inline summary. Define how we show where an insight came from, and how we handle loading, uncertainty, and wrong answers. Help shape the voice and structure of AI-generated insights, because in an LLM product the words are part of the UX.

The design system. We have a Figma library and a React component library that are only loosely in sync. You'll own the system's principles and the Figma side, and partner with our frontend engineers to make the two a single source of truth. The goal is that everyday design decisions are answered by the system, so engineers can ship UI that feels like Spate without waiting on design.

AI quality, over time. As the role settles in, you'll help define what a good AI answer looks like for our users, and contribute to how we review user feedback and evaluate our LLM features.

Requirements

What we're looking for

We care more about mindset than years of experience. You're driven, you care about making a good product, and you have a growth mindset. You value autonomy and self-direction.

  • 2+ years of product design experience, with work shipped in a real product.
  • Strong product opinions. You think about what to build and why, not just how it looks, and you're comfortable defending and revising your ideas.
  • A portfolio that shows how you framed problems, not just how you solved them. At least one case study should start from a fuzzy problem with no spec.
  • Experience with, or a strong interest in, data-heavy products such as dashboards, analytics, or reporting tools.
  • You've worked within or contributed to a design system, and understand how components and patterns scale.
  • Real curiosity about AI products, ideally with some hands-on exploration.
  • Strong written communication. We're remote and you're part-time, so your proposals and decisions need to stand on their own.
  • Experience working as a freelancer or contractor, managing your own time and deliverables.
  • Fluent in Figma, with AI tools in your everyday workflow.

Nice to have

  • Experience as the first or only designer on a team.
  • You've built or substantially evolved a design system that engineers adopted.
  • Experience designing AI features, or reviewing the quality of LLM output.
  • Depth in data visualization.
  • Familiarity with consumer goods, beauty, food, or marketing and insights tools.
  • Comfort building quick functional prototypes with AI tools to test ideas against real outputs.

Your first 90 days

  1. At 20 hours a week, we'll keep the first three months focused.
  2. First 30 days: Learn the product and the people who use it. Watch a few customer calls, review feedback and usage data, and ship your first improvements to the user experience.
  3. By day 60: Design your first feature solving a major user pain point or goal.
  4. By day 90: Work with the rest of the team to ship your feature into production.

How we work

Contributors at Spate work flexibly, with few meetings, a lot of impact, and real say over the direction of their work. Leadership sets product direction and priorities, and you shape how we get there. That means bringing proposals rather than waiting for briefs.

Our aesthetic is cool, smart, data-driven, and approachable. We want a designer who can hold that line while the product changes quickly.

This role does not include:

  • Writing production code. Figma is your main tool, and our frontend engineers build.
  • Brand and marketing design, such as the website, sales decks, or client reports.
  • Other product surfaces like our API and MCP server.

Compensation

  • Hourly rate: $75/hour.
  • About 20 hours a week, as an independent contractor.

Recruitment Process

  1. Video interview (30 min). About you, in your own words.
  2. Assessment (10 min). A quiz designed to assess your problem solving abilities and approach to work.
  3. Intro call with our frontend lead (~20 min). Your background, how you like to work, and whether the role fits.
  4. Case study (60 min). Work through a solution to a real-world problem and record your process.
  5. Case study review (45 min). Walk us through your case study, focusing on how you framed the problem and arrived at your solution.
  6. Conversation with our CEO (45 min). Product vision, how we work, and your questions.

We are looking for engineers who have personally owned meaningful technical work—such as taking a hardware system into production, validating a model against test data, developing a rigorous verification approach, or diagnosing a difficult failure.   3. Demonstrated ownership of a substantial engineering problem—for example, a product or subsystem that reached production, a model validated against physical testing, a test system you developed, or a difficult failure you diagnosed.

Role Title: STEM Expert – Chemistry & Computational Chemistry (PhD)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Job Summary: In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design, evaluate, and critique chemistry and computational chemistry problems, workflows, and reasoning chains to support AI benchmarking initiatives.
  2. Provide expert-level insights on reaction mechanisms, synthesis planning, spectroscopy analysis, molecular simulations, and electronic structure methods.
  3. Assess and optimize experimental protocols, simulation parameters, and software configurations for accuracy and reproducibility.
  4. Analyze chemical, spectroscopic, and simulation data and provide actionable recommendations.
  5. Leverage domain knowledge to guide the development and validation of chemistry-related AI models and tools.
  6. Communicate complex scientific concepts clearly, both in writing and verbally, to technical and non-technical collaborators.
  7. Document findings, methodologies, and best practices to ensure knowledge transfer across the customer’s team.

Areas of Expertise (we welcome applicants from any of the following):

  1. Organic synthesis & reaction mechanisms
  2. Inorganic & organometallic chemistry
  3. Physical & theoretical chemistry
  4. Analytical chemistry & spectroscopy
  5. Computational chemistry & molecular dynamics
  6. Cheminformatics & drug discovery
  7. Materials science & polymer chemistry

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  1. PhD in chemistry, computational chemistry, chemical biology, materials science, or a closely related field.
  2. Hands-on research lab experience, including wet lab experience for experimental subfields, or extensive simulation-heavy research for computational subfields.
  3. Deep expertise in at least one of the areas listed above.
  4. Professional written and spoken English (C1 or higher).
  5. Proficiency in Python and/or industry-standard tools in your subfield (e.g., Gaussian, ORCA, Psi4, GROMACS, LAMMPS, RDKit).
  6. Excellent quantitative, analytical, and scientific reasoning skills.
  7. Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with the ability to clearly document and explain technical concepts.
  8. Track record of rigorous scientific problem-solving in complex chemistry domains.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Academic experience (postdoc, research scientist, faculty, or equivalent), strongly preferred.
  2. Peer-reviewed publications, patents, or contributions to open-source scientific software.
  3. Experience with AI/ML-assisted chemistry workflows or benchmarking.
  4. Background in drug discovery, reaction prediction, or retrosynthesis.

raw.title: Associate Product Marketing Manager – GRC
raw.excerpt: At Mitratech, we are a team of innovators focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions.
raw.description:
At Mitratech, we are a team of innovators focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in a diverse, inclusive culture centered on great people practices, learning opportunities, and fun! Our culture blends entrepreneurial spirit with enterprise investment, giving you the chance to move quickly with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.

For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.

As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

This role is based in CAN and operates as a key member of a globally distributed marketing team, collaborating closely with colleagues across the US, UK, and EMEA to deliver consistent, high-performing digital programs at scale.

Job Overview

The Associate Product Marketing Manager, GRC will support the go-to-market strategy and execution for select products in Mitratech's GRC portfolio. This role will focus on positioning and messaging, competitive intelligence, product launches, and sales enablement, working closely with Product Marketing, Product Management, Sales, Demand Generation, and Customer Marketing. We're looking for a hands-on marketer who can own defined projects, turn complex product and market information into clear, customer-facing messaging, and collaborate effectively across teams. The ideal candidate is curious, proactive, organized, and comfortable using data and AI tools to make marketing work more efficient.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Launch & GTM Execution

  • Support go-to-market activities for new products, capabilities, and feature releases.
  • Translate product updates into launch messaging, sales materials, presentations, and other customer-facing assets.
  • Coordinate with Product Management, Demand Generation, Customer Marketing, and Sales to support launch execution.
  • Support cross-sell and upsell initiatives by developing messaging and materials that help customers understand the value of additional products and capabilities.
  • Help ensure product positioning is consistently represented across relevant marketing and sales channels.

Sales Enablement

  • Develop and maintain sales enablement materials including buyer's guides, competitive guides, presentations, FAQs, objection-handling resources, and product messaging.
  • Manage the internal sales enablement tool and sales asset repository and act as primary administrator
  • Support sales training and internal communications around new products, releases, positioning, and competitive insights.
  • Provide timely support for sales requests related to product messaging, competitive information, and deal-specific needs.

AI-Enabled Workflows

  • Use AI tools to streamline research, competitive monitoring, content development, and other repetitive marketing workflows.
  • Help test, improve, and maintain AI-assisted workflows while ensuring outputs remain accurate and aligned with business needs.
  • Come up with new ways to use AI in the PMM lifecycle and build skills and agents to assist

Competitive Intelligence & Win/Loss

  • Monitor competitors, market trends, customer needs, and developments across the GRC landscape.
  • Support the development and ongoing maintenance of competitive battlecards and sales resources for assigned products.
  • Support win/loss analysis by organizing feedback and identifying trends.

Requirements & Skills:

  • 2-3 years of relevant experience in product marketing, B2B technology, SaaS, risk, compliance, or a related field.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Marketing, or Customer teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex products and concepts for different audiences.
  • Experience creating marketing and sales enablement materials for B2B audiences.
  • Comfortable conducting market and competitive research and turning findings into practical insights and assets.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Comfortable working with marketing or business metrics and using data to inform decisions.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve research, content creation, analysis, or marketing workflows.
  • Experience in GRC, risk, compliance, cybersecurity, legal technology, or enterprise SaaS is an asset.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is an asset.

What Success Looks Like Within the first 6–12 months, you will:

  • Develop a strong understanding of Mitratech's GRC portfolio, customers, personas, and competitive landscape.
  • Become a reliable partner to Product Management and Sales on product messaging and go-to-market execution for assigned products.
  • Deliver high-quality positioning, launch, competitive, and sales enablement materials with increasing independence.
  • Contribute meaningful competitive and win/loss insights that improve messaging and sales effectiveness.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to make Product Marketing workflows more efficient.
  • Build strong relationships across Marketing, Product, Sales, and Customer teams.

This role can be performed 100% remote anywhere in Canada. Given the need for team collaboration and meeting overlap, candidates who can align with Eastern Time Zone business hours are strongly preferred. Anticipated Pay Range: $60,000 - $70,000 annually CAD.

Mitratech is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, national or ethnic origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, family status, disability, or veteran status. Mitratech will work with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process. Please email to request an accommodation.

What You’ll Do

On a daily basis, you will:

  • Manage a robust single department or multi-department sale with a 3-6 month purchasing cycle
  • Execute on a defined territory plan with specific targets to meet performance goals.
  • Generate a robust pipeline to ensure meeting sales goals.
  • Articulate how Signal Vine drives engagement and solves business problems in education
  • Deliver compelling executive and VP-level product demonstrations to prospective customers
  • Navigate unique customer procurement processes, negotiate, and close contracts
  • Update and maintain accurate pipeline data in Salesforce
  • Represent company at industry events and customer locations as needed

Who You Are

First of all, you are an accomplished sales professional with a bachelor’s degree from an accredited, four-year institution and 2-6 years of SaaS sales experience. Specifically, you should have:

  • A demonstrated track record of achieving sales quota
  • An ability to solve problems on the fly to overcome obstacles and achieve goals
  • Experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM

Additionally, during our interview, our goal will be to learn more about you and yours will be to showcase your:

  • Unwavering orientation to customer service orientation
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
  • Efficient time management and organizational skills

Finally, we’d love to see some startup experience as well. Ideally, some familiarity with EdTech and/or contacts at higher education institutions would be truly helpful, but not a deal-breaker.

What Else You Should Know

Part of the growing education technology presence in Alexandria, VA, we are located just down the road from Amazon HQ2. We’ve been recognized as one of DC’s most enviable offices by DC Inno and we offer a rewarding culture that promotes teamwork, growth, and enjoying our day to day roles. Our high growth business provides employees with a great opportunity to grow in their careers.

  • Competitive salary with individual commission structure
  • Medical (employer paid), dental, and vision insurance plans
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Generous paid time-off and holiday schedule with additional floating holidays
  • Casual office attire and pet-friendly office

What Now?

Come join us as we build an exciting company that sits at the intersection of education and cutting-edge, AI-backed technology.

If you are an entrepreneurial Account Executive seeking to join a high-performing, mission-driven team of sales professionals, Signal Vine is the place for you. We are the leading AI-powered messaging platform in the higher education market. If you are looking for just a paycheck, this position is not for you. Join us and you will be responsible for generating a robust pipeline, closing contracts, and articulating how Signal Vine drives engagement and solves business problems for higher education institutions. We are looking for go-getters who are passionate about hunting down new leads, exceeding quotas, and improving student outcomes. If you’re up to the challenge, keep reading.

Who We Are

Signal Vine is the leading Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered messaging platform transforming how higher education leaders reach, support, and engage students. We believe in the power of conversation to build communities and to strengthen the opportunity for all to succeed. We are passionate about solving education and social challenges through technology-based innovation and building a business we can all be proud of while doing it.

raw.excerpt: This is a great opportunity for a new beginning in your career with the support, the experience, and the income that are impossible to get at your current workplace.
raw.description:
This is a great opportunity for a new beginning in your career with the support, the experience, and the income that are impossible to get at your current workplace.

You will be selling custom IPTV and Digital Signage systems, equipment and software. This includes commercial user devices such as digital displays and media players. Established blue-chip customer base.

Our main office is in Melbourne, but you will be able to work from home. This role will require both domestic and international travel including regular travel to our head office. The successful candidate must be able to obtain and maintain the appropriate visas to travel throughout APAC, North America and Europe.

Key responsibilities will include the following:

  • Sell Omniscreen and other CombiTel Group products and services to customers worldwide based on an agreed strategy;
  • Plan and conduct sales calls in-person, via phone and via email;
  • Set-up and deliver product presentations at trade shows and on customer sites;
  • Proactively follow-up on new leads and marketing campaigns;
  • Maintain accurate records on our CRM system;
  • Work with the team to develop winning tender responses;
  • Prepare and deliver sales and marketing presentations;
  • Run online and social media campaigns;
  • Participate in marketing activities in Australia and overseas.

The job requires you to attend formal training as well as ongoing self-education about our products, audiovisual and communications industries, and media distribution technology in general. This challenge will be made easier by our world-class technical team.

We will help you succeed by providing quality leads, good sales tools and technical support.

Remuneration

The successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary, car allowance plus uncapped commission.

The successful candidate must have:

  • Bachelor degree or a TAFE qualification in engineering, AV, IT or a similar field;
  • Excellent communication skills;
  • Proposal writing and general document/office skills;
  • Understanding of computer software concepts, computer networking and audio visual equipment;
  • Computer and IT infrastructure skills sufficient to navigate business applications, understand our products and to setup product demonstrations;
  • Understanding of common business / financial terms;
  • Valid drivers licence;
  • Legal right to live and work in Australia.

All candidates must have the right to live and work in Australia.

When applying, please submit a cover letter addressing the job requirements and your resume containing full details of your employment history and qualifications.

Direct applicants only, no agencies please.

CombiTel's mission is to design, deploy and support complete IPTV systems, bespoke software, and best-of-breed components for service providers and enterprises in the Asian-Pacific region and worldwide. Our solutions improve quality of life in hospitals, aged care facilities, mining camps, military bases and other campuses alike.

With over 30 years of experience in telecommunications, broadcasting and applied technologies we have a proven track record of delivering IPTV and digital signage solutions that are tailored precisely to our clients’ needs and budget.

Our software development team at Omniscreen (a member of CombiTel Group) creates applications and software in-house, including our flagship product: Omniscreen Pilot. We are technologically driven - constantly creating, updating and innovating to only offer the very best solutions to our clients.

title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer
description: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Fullstack Engineer with strong experience in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.

raw.title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer
raw.excerpt: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Fullstack Engineer with strong experience in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.
raw.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Fullstack Engineer with strong experience in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, and NestJS to design, develop, and maintain scalable applications and services for the healthcare industry. This role focuses on building modern web applications, backend services, and system integrations while ensuring high standards of performance, security, and reliability.

The ideal candidate has a solid understanding of modern web development, enjoys building intuitive user interfaces, and is comfortable developing and integrating backend services. You will work with a modern AI-Driven technology stack that includes React, TypeScript, NodeJS, and Medplum, contributing to the development of healthcare solutions that improve clinical workflows and user experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using React, TypeScript, and JavaScript.

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and RESTful APIs using Node.js and NestJS.

  • Develop reusable frontend components, custom hooks, and modular application architectures following modern development best practices.

  • Design, develop, and integrate RESTful APIs with internal and third-party systems.

  • Implement authentication, authorization, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) to ensure secure access to application functionality and sensitive data.

  • Develop responsive, accessible, and user-friendly interfaces based on UI/UX designs and accessibility best practices.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, technical specifications, and healthcare-related workflows.

  • Write and maintain unit and integration tests to ensure application quality, reliability, and maintainability.

  • Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and promoting clean coding standards.

  • Troubleshoot application issues, identify root causes, and implement maintainable solutions.

  • Ensure sensitive healthcare information is handled securely in application code, logs, integrations, and error-handling processes.

  • Take ownership of assigned features throughout the software development lifecycle, from technical design and implementation to testing and delivery.

  • Create and maintain technical documentation for application components, APIs, and integrations.

  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve coding efficiency, code quality, and development workflows.

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, communicate development progress, and proactively identify and escalate technical risks or blockers.

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on experience in fullstack web application development.

  • Advanced proficiency in React, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3.

  • Strong hands-on experience developing backend applications and RESTful APIs using Node.js, NestJS, and TypeScript.

  • Experience designing and implementing Single Page Applications (SPAs), reusable components, custom hooks, and modular frontend architectures.

  • Strong experience building, consuming, and integrating RESTful APIs, including asynchronous operations and error handling.

  • Practical experience integrating LLM APIs, tool calling, or agentic AI workflows into software applications.

  • Experience with Spec-Driven Development or AI-driven Software Development Lifecycle practices to improve development efficiency, code quality, and software delivery.

  • Experience implementing authentication, authorization, and secure application development practices.

  • Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and clean coding principles.

  • Experience with automated testing, including Jest, React Testing Library, or similar testing frameworks.

  • Experience developing responsive and accessible web applications, including familiarity with WCAG accessibility guidelines.

  • Experience working with Git, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, and code review processes.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical deliverables, and adapt to changing requirements.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with experience collaborating with cross-functional and international teams.

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

Preferred

  • Experience developing applications for the healthcare industry or other regulated environments.

  • Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 FHIR.

  • Experience with Medplum or similar healthcare platforms for managing clinical data and electronic health records.

  • Understanding of healthcare data privacy and security requirements, including HIPAA and the protection of Protected Health Information (PHI).

  • Experience with backend development using Python or other server-side technologies.

  • Experience using Figma to implement UI designs and collaborate with design teams.

Perks you enjoy at KMSMexico

  • Mexican law benefits
  • 15 days of PTO (in year zero, from the first year onwards it is 3 days per year).
  • 5 days' leave for the death of immediate family members, negotiable.
  • Major Medical Expenses Insurance with coverage for immediate dependents (spouse and children).
  • Annual performance bonus (≈10% of annualized salary).
  • Annual salary adjustment.
  • Employee Referral Bonus.
  • Paid Certifications / Courses
  • Coursera License.
  • 5% Savings Fund.
  • 5% Grocery Vouchers.

KMS provides the enterprise execution layer, where work becomes outcomes.

We are a global, AI-native technology services company focused on Enterprise Execution. We help enterprises build and modernize applications, create trusted data foundations, put AI into production, and continuously run and improve the systems that execute the work.

raw.title: Data Migration and Integration Consultant (HR/Payroll Systems)
raw.excerpt: Harbor is looking for a Data Migration and Integration Consultant to join our HR and payroll transformation practice.
raw.description:
Harbor is looking for a Data Migration and Integration Consultant to join our HR and payroll transformation practice. This is a technical consulting role at the heart of our delivery work, responsible for moving client data safely and accurately into modern HR platforms and for designing and building the integrations that keep those platforms connected to the wider technology landscape.

You will work across engagements involving SAP SuccessFactors, Workday and Oracle HCM, taking clients from messy, fragmented legacy data through to clean, validated go live loads, and from integration requirements through to tested, supportable interfaces. The role suits someone who enjoys the detail of data work but can also explain it clearly to HR and business stakeholders who do not speak in file formats.

This is a remote position based in the UK, with travel to client sites as needed.

What you will do:

Data migration

  • Lead and deliver data migration workstreams into SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or Oracle HCM, from strategy and planning through to go live and hypercare
  • Define migration approaches, including scoping of data objects, load sequencing, cutover plans and rollback positions
  • Profile and assess legacy data quality, identifying gaps, duplicates and inconsistencies, and agreeing cleansing ownership with the client
  • Design and maintain mapping and transformation rules between legacy sources and target system structures
  • Build, execute and reconcile data loads across multiple test cycles, mock conversions and production cutover
  • Produce validation and reconciliation reporting that gives clients confidence in the accuracy and completeness of migrated data
  • Advise clients on data retention, archiving and the treatment of historical records

Integration design and delivery

  • Gather and document integration requirements across HR, payroll, benefits, finance and third party providers
  • Produce integration designs and specifications covering data flows, transformation logic, error handling, scheduling and security
  • Build, test and deploy integrations using platform native tooling and middleware
  • Support end to end and payroll parallel testing, resolving defects across connected systems
  • Define monitoring, error resolution and support processes so that integrations are sustainable after go live
  • Advise clients on integration architecture, including the trade offs between point to point connections, middleware and file based approaches

ETL and data engineering

  • Use ETL tooling to extract, transform and load data at scale across migration and integration workstreams
  • Develop repeatable, auditable transformation routines rather than one off manual manipulation
  • Automate validation and reconciliation checks where practical to reduce cycle times and manual effort
  • Contribute to the development of practice accelerators, templates and reusable migration assets

Client and practice contribution

  • Act as the trusted technical voice on engagements, translating data and integration matters into plain language for HR and programme stakeholders
  • Support proposals, scoping and estimating for migration and integration workstreams
  • Coach junior consultants and share technical knowledge across the team

What we are looking for:

Essential

  • Proven data migration experience into at least one of SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or Oracle HCM, across multiple full lifecycle projects
  • Integration design and technical delivery experience, including producing specifications and building and testing interfaces
  • Hands on experience with ETL tooling and confidence manipulating large, imperfect datasets
  • Strong understanding of HR and payroll data structures, including the sensitivities around personal data and the importance of accuracy at cutover
  • Experience running reconciliation and validation across test cycles and production loads
  • Clear communicator, able to work with both technical teams and HR stakeholders
  • Right to work in the UK and willingness to travel to client sites when needed

Desirable

  • Experience across more than one of the three target platforms
  • Knowledge of platform specific tooling such as Workday EIB, Core Connectors and Studio, SAP Integration Suite and Infoporter, or Oracle HDL and OIC
  • Experience with payroll migrations and parallel run reconciliation
  • Familiarity with UK GDPR and the data protection considerations that apply to migration and integration work
  • Exposure to professional services or legal sector clients
  • Consulting experience, or client-side experience with a clear consulting mindset

What you can expect:

  • Varied technical work across three major HR platforms, rather than being tied to a single technology
  • A collaborative practice with direct access to senior leadership and genuine input into how we grow
  • Investment in platform certifications and wider professional development
  • Competitive salary, bonus and benefits, with flexible and remote working supported

About Us:

Harbor is the preeminent provider of expert services across strategy, legal technology, operations, and intelligence. Our globally integrated team of 900+ strategists, technologists, and specialists navigate alongside our clients – leading law firms, corporations, and their law departments – to provide essential resources and invaluable insights. Anchored in a rich heritage of deep knowledge, steadfast relationships, and mutual respect, our unwavering dedication lies in shaping the future of the legal industry and fostering enduring partnerships within our community and ecosystem.

Harbor is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, civil union status, national origin, ancestry, age, parental status, disabled status, veteran status, or any other legally protected classification, in accordance with applicable law.

raw.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit .

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE JOB

We are seeking a Sustainability Analyst to be a core contributor to Live Nation’s sustainability programs. This role delivers high-quality, accurate sustainability data that informs our strategy, supports audits, and gives the business insights help manage costs, reduce risk, and make informed operational decisions. The analyst manages recurring reporting cycles, works proactively with teams across our global markets, and helps improve how we collect and use data. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with initiative, clear communication, and a passion for sustainability.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

Data Management and Quality Assurance – 35%

  • Collect, organize, and maintain environmental, operational, and financial data (e.g. energy, waste, and water usage, utility costs and invoices, venue and event activity) from multiple sources.
  • Conduct quality checks to ensure data integrity and accuracy, including reconciling usage data against invoices and financial records.
  • Support the audit process by preparing data summaries, responding to auditor requests, and maintaining documentation.

Analytics and Reporting – 25%

  • Develop and manage Tableau dashboards for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Analyze trends in usage, cost, and operational performance to identify savings opportunities and areas for improvement.
  • Assist in preparing presentations, reports, and sustainability communications, translating data into clear takeaways for non-technical audiences.

Project Management – 15%

  • Manage timelines and deliverables for recurring data cycles, including annual reporting, audit, and regional data collection.
  • Coordinate inputs across regional contacts, venues, and internal teams, tracking progress and following up to keep work on schedule.
  • Lead improvement projects from scoping through rollout, such as onboarding new data sources or launching new dashboards.

Stakeholder Engagement – 15%

  • Proactively engage stakeholders (operations, sustainability, finance, and regional teams) on a regular basis to understand their business needs and to confirm that our data, dashboards, and reporting are delivering against them.
  • Serve as a point of contact for regional teams on data requests, guidance, and troubleshooting.
  • Actively participate in team and cross-functional meetings, contributing ideas, sharing updates, and raising issues early.

Process Improvement – 10%

  • Maintain and continuously improve Live Nation's sustainability data platform and data management systems.
  • Partner with internal finance and fintech teams to streamline data workflows, enhance automation, and improve integration between financial, operational, and environmental data.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Demonstrated experience managing, analyzing, and quality-checking data from multiple sources, with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to read and interpret utility invoices (electricity, gas, water, waste), including usage, units, rates, and billing periods.
  • Working knowledge of greenhouse gas accounting, including Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions, emission factors, and unit conversions.
  • Proficiency in Excel (lookups, pivot tables, data cleaning, reconciliation) and proficiency in Tableau or a similar data visualization tool.
  • Experience improving data processes, such as standardizing collection templates, streamlining workflows, or supporting automation.
  • Proven ability to manage projects and competing deadlines.
  • A proactive approach to working with stakeholders: comfortable reaching out, asking questions, and contributing in meetings.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining data to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a creative, fast-paced, global environment.
  • Preferred: Familiarity with environmental reporting standards and frameworks (e.g. GHG Protocol, CDP, CSRD), and experience supporting a third-party audit or assurance process.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act and consistent with other similar and / or applicable laws in other areas.

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job should contact a Human Resources Representative to request the opportunity to participate in a timely interactive process. Live Nation will also provide reasonable religious accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

HIRING PRACTICES
The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

Live Nation recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Live Nation may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms. Live Nation may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support application screening and assessment. All hiring decisions are made with human review.

The expected compensation for this position is:

$72,000.00 USD - $90,000.00 USD

** Pay is based on a number of factors including market location, qualifications, skills, and experience.

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

raw.description:
PKI JD
Summary:
We are looking for a PKI/CLM Engineer with hands-on experience in ADCS, AWS ACM, and Venafi to design, implement, and manage enterprise PKI and Certificate Lifecycle Management services. The role includes certificate automation, policy enforcement, infrastructure and application integration, and ensuring compliance with security and audit standards. Required skills include CRL and OCSP maintenance, AWS Key Vault, cloud and hybrid environments, and PowerShell scripting for automation.
Roles Responsibilities: -
Manage enterprise PKI infrastructure including Root and Issuing Certificate.
Responsibilities:
  • Manage certificate lifecycle activities: issuance, renewal, revocation, rekey, rollover, and retirement.
  • Configure and maintain Offline Root CA, Issuing CAs, certificate templates/profiles, and policy constraints.
  • Manage CRL/OCSP publishing and ensure high availability.
  • Maintain PKI documentation aligned with standards like CP/CPS, operational runbooks, and SOPs.
  • Support audits and compliance requirements, including CAB Forum standards.
  • Manage and monitor PKI/HSM operations end-to-end, including health checks, backups, configurations, and policies.
  • Implement and maintain processes for managing internal and external certificate lifecycles.
  • Monitor certificates for expiration, perform timely renewals, and revoke compromised or obsolete certificates.
  • Possess strong technical expertise in Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (ADCS), including OCSP, CRLs, certificate templates, key archival, and NDES/SCEP.
  • Proficient in scripting and automation, especially PowerShell, with the ability to integrate PKI solutions across platforms such as network devices, load balancers, and Windows/Linux environments.
  • Have solid understanding of cryptography and encryption standards, including TLS, X.509, RSA/ECC, CSRs, and secure key management with HSMs and TPMs.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-based certificate and key management; strong troubleshooting skills; exposure to AWS ACM/PCA, Venafi tools, and relevant security or PKI certifications is advantageous.
  • Assist with enterprise-wide certificate lifecycle tasks, including requests, issuance, renewal, and revocation.
  • Maintain and update inventories of machine identities, including certificates, keys, and service credentials.

  • Monitor adherence to governance controls and escalate exceptions or risks.

  • Identify and report at-risk certificates, including expired, soon-to-expire, weak cryptography, or unknown owners.
  • Assist with certificate issuance requests and validate required information.
  • Demonstrate experience managing enterprise-scale PKI environments across on-premises and cloud platforms, including lifecycle management and automation (e.g., Venafi Trust Protection Platform).

  • Knowledge of AD, DNS, IAM operations, and CyberArk Privilege Cloud is beneficial.
