raw.description:
Real people. Real service.

At SupplyHouse.com, we value every individual team member and cultivate a community where people come first. Led by our core values of Generosity, Respect, Innovation, Teamwork, and GRIT, we’re dedicated to maintaining a supportive work environment that celebrates diversity and empowers everyone to reach their full potential. As an industry-leading e-commerce company specializing in HVAC, plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies since 2004, we strive to foster growth while providing the best possible experience for our customers.

We are looking for a Marketplace Onboarding Manager (or a Marketplace Operations Manager as we like to call it!) to join our Product Team. This individual will report into our Senior Manager, Category Management and will be responsible for the day-to-day operational health of SupplyHouse’s third-party marketplace channel. This role ensures that marketplace performance is continuously monitored, supplier onboarding is executed efficiently, and catalog and listing quality standards are upheld. If you are interested in finding and onboarding new marketplace suppliers and building a pipeline of qualified partners, we want to hear from you!

This remote position is open to individuals who live in, or are open to relocating to, the following states: Arizona, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.

This position requires travel to our headquarters in Melville, NY 3 times per year for internal meetings and team building activities. We reimburse reasonable and necessary travel expenses, and you’re also welcome to work on-site anytime beyond these visits – our doors are always open.

Role Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Location: Remote

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. with time zone flexibility

Base Salary: The expected starting salary for the position is $92,940 to $116,175 within a full position range of $92,940 to $139,410 annually. This range reflects the long-term earning potential for the role. Our starting pay practice is the minimum to middle portion of the range, depending on experience, qualifications, and internal equity, consistent with applicable law and it is rare for a new hire to start above the midpoint.

Responsibilities:

  • Proactively research and identify new marketplace supplier candidates across target categories, using competitive analysis, industry resources, and internal category gaps as inputs
  • Conduct initial outreach to prospective suppliers, articulate SupplyHouse’s marketplace value proposition, and manage the early-stage relationship through qualification
  • Coordinate with Category Management to prioritize and schedule new supplier conversations, ensuring alignment with category strategy before advancing candidates
  • Own the end-to-end onboarding process for approved suppliers, including agreement coordination, contract administration, data requirements communication, and timeline management
  • Lead technical feed setup and validation for new suppliers—mapping product data, verifying feed accuracy, and resolving data quality issues prior to go-live
  • Train new suppliers on SupplyHouse’s systems, data standards, and operational requirements, ensuring they are set up for long-term success on the platform
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for new suppliers through the onboarding period, troubleshooting issues and maintaining momentum to hit go-live milestones
  • Document onboarding processes and maintain SOPs to ensure consistent, repeatable execution as the supplier base grows
  • Develop and maintain claims, warranty, and returns processes for marketplace suppliers, ensuring clear guidelines and consistent execution across the supplier base
  • Monitor post-launch supplier performance and flag issues with service levels, data quality, or accounting discrepancies for resolution
  • Review weekly feeds for new item suggestions and coordinate with Category Management on additions
  • Research competitor listings to identify opportunities for improvement in content, imagery, and positioning
  • Conduct image audits and data cleanup including attribute and filter updates on new brand
  • Own SOP creation and ongoing maintenance for marketplace operational workflows
  • Test and document new marketplace features and platform capabilities within the supplier dashboards
  • Execute ad hoc operational projects including data cleanup, content audits, and cross-system reconciliation
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Merchandising, Pricing, and Supply Chain teams to resolve issues and support execution
  • Respond to basic marketplace customer inquiries escalated from Customer Service or order fulfillment, and review processed returns to identify trends
  • Reconcile discrepancies between freight and non-freight shipping methods and partner with Product Catalog to update item dimensions as needed
  • Monitor out-of-stock items and communicate gaps to the Merchandising team; support price update processes to maintain alignment between SupplyHouse and supplier pricing

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in in Business, Marketing, Merchandising, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)
  • A minimum of 3-5 years of experience in marketplace operations, e-commerce merchandising, or a related field
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales and inventory data and translate findings into action
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort working across multiple data systems and reporting tools
  • Experience managing supplier or vendor relationships in an operational capacity
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and shifting priorities
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across cross-functional teams
  • Proven ability to document processes and create SOPs in a structured, repeatable format

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with marketplace platforms (e.g., Amazon, Home Depot, Walmart, or similar) or B2B e-commerce environments
  • Familiarity with product feed management, catalog systems, or MDM tools
  • Experience in plumbing, HVAC, or trade supply distribution is a plus

Why work with us:

  • We have awesome benefits – We offer a wide variety of benefits to help support you and your loved ones. These include:
    • Comprehensive and affordable medical, dental, vision, and voluntary life insurance options
    • 401(k) with up to 4% company match
    • Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays
    • Company-paid basic life insurance and long-term disability
    • Discounted auto, home, and pet insurance programs
    • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
    • Confidential mental health, financial planning, and legal support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
    • Company-provided equipment and one-time $250 work from home stipend
    • $750 annual professional development budget
    • $25 monthly Grubhub credit
    • Company rewards and recognition program
    • And more!
  • We empower ownership – We all contribute to our success and we all share in it. Our Ownership for All program ensures each SupplyHouse team member will benefit financially from the company’s growth and accomplishments.
  • We promote work-life balance –We value your time and encourage a healthy separation between your professional and personal life to feel refreshed and recharged. Look out for our wellness initiatives and ask about our Flex-Time Policy!
  • We support growth –We encourage you to embrace continuous learning and take on new challenges. In an exciting and evolving industry, we provide opportunities for career growth through our annual merit and bonus opportunities, hands-on training, diversity and inclusion initiatives, internal mobility options, and professional development budget.
  • We give back – We live and breathe our core value, Generosity, by giving back to the trades and organizations around the world. We make a difference through donation drives, employee-nominated contributions, support for non-profit organizations, Volunteer Paid Time Off, and more.
  • We listen – We value hearing from our employees. Everyone has a voice, and we encourage you to use it! We actively elicit feedback through our monthly town halls, regular 1:1 check-ins, employee listening initiatives, and company-wide ideas form to incorporate suggestions and ensure our team enjoys coming to work every day.

Check us out and learn more at: !

Additional Details:

  • Remote employees are expected to work in a distraction-free environment. Personal devices, background noise, and other distractions should be kept to a minimum to avoid disrupting virtual meetings or business operations.

  • To ensure fairness and trust in our hiring process, we ask that all application materials, assessments, and interview responses reflect your own thinking and perspective. You may use AI tools to assist in preparing your responses, as long as this use is clearly disclosed and you can speak authentically to your ideas and work. Our focus is on honesty, judgment, and how you approach problem-solving. We appreciate your transparency and look forward to learning more about your skills.

raw.description:
PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH

Location: Remote, Latin America (LATAM)

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Openings: 2

Industry: Real Estate Finance / Private Lending

Compensation: $1,700 to $2,300 USD/month

Experience: 1.5+ years at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender

Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET)

English Proficiency: Advanced written and spoken English required

Start Date: As soon as possible (early November 2026)

About the Company

Our client is a U.S.-based private real estate lender that provides short-term, business-purpose loans to real estate investors.

The company finances Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR rental and Ground-Up Construction projects, working closely with borrowers, brokers, originators and capital partners to deliver fast, reliable funding.

As its loan volume grows, the company is building out its remote operations team to keep every loan file accurate, complete and moving on time.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Loan Processor & Underwriter to own underwriting, loan file completeness and follow-up on every file through the satisfaction of underwriting conditions.

You will analyze borrower, property and deal risk, collect and verify documentation, manage appraisals, and keep borrowers, brokers and originators informed until each loan is ready to close.

This is not a data entry or conventional mortgage processing role. We are looking for someone with real underwriting and processing experience at a hard money or private lender, who brings strong judgment, persistence and excellent borrower service.

What You'll Do

Underwriting

  • Underwrite business-purpose Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR and Ground-Up Construction loans.
  • Analyze credit, borrower experience, liquidity, LTV/LTC, as-is value, ARV, DSCR, construction budgets and exit strategy.
  • Approve loans within delegated guidelines and escalate exceptions.

Loan File Management

  • Collect, verify and organize borrower, guarantor, entity and property documents.
  • Maintain accurate conditions and loan files in the company's loan portal and CRM.

Appraisal Review

  • Order, track and review appraisals, including comparable sales and values.
  • Work with the appraisal management company on corrections or reconsiderations.
  • Promptly advise the originator of any material changes in value or risk.

Follow-Up & Communication

  • Proactively follow up with borrowers, brokers, originators and vendors until all outstanding documents and conditions are resolved.
  • Respond promptly and deliver outstanding service to borrowers, brokers and partners.

Closing Support

  • Coordinate with the closer on underwriting-related items through funding.
  • Correct any underwriting deficiencies identified after closing.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 1.5 years of hands-on experience at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender, originating or servicing business-purpose investment property loans (Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR and/or Ground-Up Construction).
  • Practical underwriting and loan processing experience at a comparable lender.
  • Advanced written and spoken English.
  • High attention to detail and strong analytical skills.
  • Ability to work in Gmail, GoHighLevel (GHL) or a similar CRM, and an online loan portal for documents, files and workflow.
  • Hardworking, dependable, proactive and accountable. You take ownership and follow up without reminders.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced lending business, handling urgent requests and meeting deadlines without compromising accuracy or controls.
  • Availability to work 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

Please note: conventional consumer mortgage experience alone (FHA, VA, Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac loans) does not meet the experience requirement.

How Success Is Measured

  • Loan files are complete, accurate and organized at every stage.
  • Underwriting decisions are well supported and stay within guidelines.
  • Outstanding conditions are cleared quickly, with minimal reminders.
  • Appraisal issues and material changes are flagged early.
  • Borrowers, brokers and originators receive timely, professional updates.

Why Join Us?

  • Fully Remote Opportunity: Work from anywhere in Latin America with a U.S.-based lender.
  • Competitive Compensation: Earn $1,700 to $2,300 USD per month.
  • Meaningful Responsibility: Own loan files from underwriting through clear to close.
  • Professional Growth: Deepen your experience in U.S. private real estate lending.

Important Notes

  • Candidates must reside in Latin America.
  • Direct experience at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender is required.
  • Availability to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours is required.
  • Excellent English communication skills are essential.
  • Please submit your CV in English and include the lender(s) you worked for, your dates of employment and the loan types you handled.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

At Marie Curie, our values are central to everything we do. They guide how we care for people, how we work together, and how we make decisions every day. We are committed to creating a workplace that is safe for everyone — staff and volunteers alike — supportive, inclusive and rewarding. We take stringent steps to ensure that anyone who joins our organisation are suitable for their roles and are committed to safeguarding all our people from harm. We actively consider our impact on the planet, embedding sustainability into everyday decisions to create a lasting, positive difference for the individuals we care for and the world we share.

We believe everyone should have the opportunity to thrive and fulfil their potential. Marie Curie is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion, recognising both the social justice imperative and the strength a diverse workforce brings. We actively encourage applications from people of all cultures, perspectives and lived experiences.

We are happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process. If you require any support, please contact us at .

Every application we receive is personally reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team, and in return, we ask that your application authentically reflects you — your experience, perspective and voice.

Marie Curie is the UK’s leading end-of-life charity. We are the largest non-NHS provider of end-of-life care in the UK, the only provider across all 4 nations, delivering community nursing and hospice care across the country, while providing information and support on all aspects of dying, death, and bereavement. Our leading research pushes the boundaries of what we know about good end-of-life, and our campaigns fight for a world where everyone gets to have the best possible quality of life while living with an illness, they’re likely to die from.

The care and support we provide is highly valued by the people we care for and their loved ones, but at present we are only reaching around 10% of dying people at the end of life. Right now, one in four people in the UK with a terminal illness, do not get the care or support they deserve at the end of their lives.

We want a different society than the one we live in now. Our mission for the next five years is to close the gap in the number of people missing out on what they need at the end-of-life, through 3 ways:

• Growing and transforming our direct care and support

• Delivering more practical information and support

• Leading in shaping the end-of-life experience

This role will also be responsible for building and mentoring a high-performing team to deliver exceptional service to our clients.

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Data Acquisition Director leads Humana's EHR data acquisition portfolio, with responsibility for strategy, roadmap execution, and product team leadership across clinical data acquisition capabilities. This role oversees products focused on medical records retrieval, supplemental clinical data, appointment and ADT data, and future interoperability opportunities. The Director is accountable for aligning portfolio investments with enterprise priorities, advancing data acquisition capabilities, developing product management talent, and ensuring products deliver measurable business value. The position serves as the primary leader responsible for scaling and modernizing Humana's EHR data acquisition strategy.

The Data Acquisition Director provides strategic and operational leadership for Humana's EHR data acquisition portfolio. The role owns portfolio vision, investment planning, roadmap governance, and execution oversight across products that support the acquisition, exchange, and utilization of provider and clinical data. This leader manages Product Managers and Product Owners responsible for medical records, supplemental data, appointment data, ADT feeds, and future interoperability capabilities.


The Director partners with vendor management, implementation teams, technology organizations, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities for growth, improve data acquisition effectiveness, and expand Humana's access to clinical information through EHR partnerships. Responsibilities include portfolio prioritization, strategic planning, product performance management, talent development, and executive communication. The role exercises significant independent judgment while balancing long-term strategy with operational execution and business outcomes


Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the Data Acquisition portfolio strategy
  • Lead Product Managers and Product Owners within the portfolio
  • Establish multi-year roadmap and investment priorities
  • Drive expansion of clinical and provider data acquisition capabilities
  • Partner with EHR vendors to support interoperability and data exchange opportunities
  • Monitor portfolio performance, adoption, utilization, and business outcomes
  • Develop product management capabilities and talent within the organization
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, vendor capabilities, and market opportunities
  • Drive alignment between enterprise priorities and portfolio investments
  • Provide executive updates, recommendations, and strategic direction for the data portfolio


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of experience in product management, healthcare technology, interoperability, data acquisition, or related fields
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience
  • Experience leading product portfolios and multi-year roadmap development
  • Experience developing business cases and investment recommendations
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams to influence organizational priorities
  • Knowledge of healthcare data exchange, interoperability, and provider workflows

Preferred Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience working with EHR vendors including Epic, Oracle Health, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, Veradigm, or similar platforms
  • Experience managing clinical data acquisition, interoperability, or health information exchange products
  • Familiarity with value-based care, risk adjustment, quality improvement, and population health initiatives
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen

Additional Information

  • This role is considered "remote/work at home" and can be based anywhere in the United States.
  • The expected start date for this role is targeted for January 2027.
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$168,000 - $231,000 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 11-02-2026


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​

It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. raw.description:
An Amazing Career Opportunity for a Sales Director, HID Textile Services!!

Location: Remote (US)

Job ID: 51406

HID Global's Identification Technologies Business Area seeks an experienced, hands-on Sales Director to lead growth for HID Textile Services. This is a player-coach role with direct responsibility for building and leading the sales team while carrying a personal quota. The Sales Director will set sales priorities, strengthen pipeline quality and conversion, coach regional sellers, and maintain accountability for forecast and revenue delivery. The individual will also personally originate and lead strategic hospitality-group opportunities and selected high-value hotel deals across HID InvoTech Uniform Management, HID Acuity and Invotion Linen Management, and related RFID textile solutions. Success requires the ability to operate at both executive and property level, translate operational challenges into compelling business cases, and convert emerging-category interest into profitable revenue.

Who are we?

HID powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely.

We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,500 worldwide employees. Check us out here: and

Identification Technologies (IDT):

IDT is creating trusted identities for IoT applications through Smart Components and Enabling Services.

HID’s Identification Technologies powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places and things through smart components and cloud services. We make it possible for people and organizations to transact safely, work productively, and travel freely. Our contactless identification and sensing (RFID, NFC, and BLE) components and solution enabling technologies address the dynamic requirements across multiple industries to wirelessly connect, identify, collect and manage data quickly and accurately across virtually any IoT application.

As our Sales Director, HID Textile Services, you’ll support HID’s success by:

  • Developing and leading the HID Textile Services sales organization, setting commercial priorities, role mandates, territory coverage, account ownership, quotas, and performance expectations.
  • Carrying a personal sales quota and directly originating, leading, and closing strategic hospitality-group opportunities and selected high-value individual hotel deals.
  • Building senior relationships with hotel owners, operators, management companies, procurement organizations, laundries, linen suppliers, and other strategic industry stakeholders.
  • Coaching sellers through discovery, qualification, value quantification, economic-buyer access, proposal strategy, negotiation, and close activities; intervening directly when leadership materially improves the probability of winning.
  • Establishing and enforcing a disciplined sales operating rhythm covering pipeline creation, stage criteria, deal reviews, forecast accuracy, conversion, win/loss learning, and corrective actions.
  • Developing repeatable go-to-market plays for HID InvoTech Uniform Management, HID Acuity and Invotion Linen Management, RFID textile tags, and partner-led opportunities.
  • Recruiting, onboarding, developing, and managing sales talent; addressing performance gaps promptly and building active hunter capability across the team.
  • Coordinating strategic accounts and cross-regional pursuits to ensure customers receive clear ownership and HID resources are deployed effectively.
  • Partnering with Product Management, Marketing, Operations, Customer Success, Finance, and leadership to strengthen offers, pricing, ROI tools, implementation readiness, and market activation.
  • Representing HID with senior customers and at relevant industry events, monitoring market and competitive developments, and translating customer insights into business priorities.

Your Experience and Background include:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant commercial leadership experience.
  • Minimum 8 years of successful B2B sales or business development experience, including demonstrated leadership of solution-sales teams.
  • Proven record of personally closing strategic, multi-location, or enterprise opportunities and developing relationships with senior customer decision-makers.
  • Experience selling into hospitality, hotel technology, commercial laundry, linen or uniform services, textile services, or a closely related industry.
  • Prior experience in commercial laundry or commercial laundry, linen or uniform services, textile services industry.
  • Proven success managing long-cycle, multi-stakeholder sales involving software, hardware, recurring services, operational change, or capital approval; RFID experience is an advantage but is not required.
  • Demonstrated success as a player-coach who can lead a sales team while personally developing and closing material business.
  • Strong understanding of hospitality operations and the ability to build credibility with hotel-group executives, owners, management companies, property leaders, procurement, finance, laundries, and linen suppliers.
  • Executive-level solution-selling skills, including discovery, value quantification, business-case development, negotiation, and complex deal leadership.
  • Ability to assess pipeline quality, distinguish genuine customer commitment from general interest, and focus the organization on opportunities with a credible path to revenue.
  • Strong coaching and performance-management capability, with clear expectations, constructive challenge, and consistent follow-through.
  • Commercial judgment and analytical discipline across forecasting, pricing, account prioritization, resource allocation, and sales productivity.
  • Proficiency with CRM and prospecting tools, including Salesforce and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

What we can offer you:

  • Competitive salary and rewards package
  • Competitive benefits and annual leave offering, allowing for work-life balance
  • A vibrant, welcoming & inclusive culture
  • Extensive career development opportunities and resources to maximize your potential
  • To be a part of a global organization that is pioneering the hardware, software and services that allow people to confidently navigate the physical and digital worlds

Why apply?

  • Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
  • Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. You'll have opportunities to share insights and contribute forward-thinking ideas that shape future outcomes.
  • Integrity: You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted.

The wage range for this role considers a broad scope of factors that are considered when making compensation decisions, including but not limited to: skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range does not account for geographic differentials based on the location where the position may be filled. At HID, it is uncommon for individuals to be hired at or near the top of the range. Final compensation decisions depend on the specific facts and circumstances of each case.

The base salary in the United States is $160,000 to $180,000. The OTE is up to $300,000.

This opportunity may be open to flexible working arrangements.

HID does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. We are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

HID is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce that reflects the global communities we serve. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Our goal is to create a workplace that empowers everyone to thrive and be their authentic selves, fostering an environment of mutual respect and inclusivity.If you have a disability and require assistance or accommodation to participate in the application process or to perform essential job functions, please contact .

Immigration Sponsorship Not Available

  • Applicants for this position must be currently and legally authorized to reside and work in the hiring country.
  • HID Global will not offer immigration sponsorship or assume sponsorship of an employment visa for this position.
  • International relocation or remote work arrangements outside of the hiring country will not be considered.

At times, HID may use AI-assisted technology to help our Talent Acquisition team review applications by identifying job-related qualifications, skills, and experience in résumés and comparing them with the requirements of the role. The technology supports recruiter reviews but does not make hiring decisions. A member of our Talent Acquisition team reviews each application before any selection decision is made.Information processed by the tool is deleted once the recruiter's review is complete.

We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!
On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.

When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

At Mitratech, we are a team of innovators focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in its diverse and inclusive work culture centered around great people practices, learning opportunities, and having fun! Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.

For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.

As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

Job Overview

We are seeking a Paid Digital Marketing Manager to own and scale our paid digital strategy for Mitratech’s Workforce Compliance and HR Solutions portfolio, including Background Screening, I-9 Compliance, HR Compliance & Expertise, and Leave Management solutions.

This role is responsible for planning, executing, optimizing, and reporting on paid digital programs that drive qualified demand across the full sales and marketing funnel. You’ll work closely with product marketing, demand generation, sales, and revenue operations to ensure paid media programs are data-driven, AI-enabled, and tightly aligned to pipeline and revenue goals.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role ideal for a performance marketer who is comfortable operating both strategically and tactically in a B2B SaaS environment.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Paid Media Strategy & Execution

  • Ensure alignment of all paid digital initiatives with business priorities, solution-level goals, and defined KPIs, including pipeline contribution, revenue impact, and efficiency metrics.
  • Develop, execute, and optimize paid digital programs across channels, including paid search (Google Ads and Bing Ads), paid social (LinkedIn, Meta), display, retargeting, and B2B review and marketplace platforms (e.g., Capterra, Software Advice, SHRM MediaBrains) to support pipeline and revenue targets.
  • Own channel-level budgeting, forecasting, pacing, and performance optimization across multiple HR solutions and buyer personas.
  • Translate product positioning and campaign strategy into high-performing paid media programs aligned to each stage of the buyer journey.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to ensure messaging, keywords, and creative reflect compliance-driven value propositions and customer pain points.

AI-Forward & Data-Driven Marketing

  • Leverage AI-powered bidding, audience targeting, creative testing, and optimization tools within paid platforms to improve efficiency and performance.
  • Use AI and automation to scale keyword expansion, ad variation testing, audience segmentation, and performance insights.
  • Apply predictive and behavioral data to inform spend allocation, audience prioritization, and conversion optimization.
  • Continuously evaluate and pilot emerging AI-driven advertising tools and capabilities to maintain a competitive edge.

Optimization, Testing & Analytics

  • Prepare and present performance insights, recommendations, and strategic readouts to senior marketing leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, including C-suite and executive audiences, translating complex data into clear business impact.
  • Design and manage A/B and multivariate tests across ads, landing pages, audiences, and offers to improve conversion rates and CPL.
  • Monitor performance against KPIs, including CPL, CAC, conversion rate, pipeline contribution, and ROI.
  • Analyze campaign, channel, and cohort-level data to deliver actionable insights and recommendations to marketing and sales leadership.
  • Partner with web and CRO teams to optimize landing page experience, conversion paths, and form strategy.

Martech, Attribution & Collaboration

  • Manage and optimize integrations between paid platforms, marketing automation (HubSpot), CRM (Salesforce), and analytics tools.
  • Ensure clean tracking, attribution, and reporting across the funnel in collaboration with Revenue Operations.
  • Work cross-functionally with to align paid programs to active campaigns, events, and sales priorities.
  • Manage external vendors or agencies as needed to support execution and scale.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Requirements & Skills:

Required Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in paid digital marketing, performance marketing, or demand generation within a B2B SaaS or technology environment.
  • Hands-on experience managing paid search (Google/Bing), paid social (LinkedIn), display, and retargeting campaigns.
  • Strong understanding of full-funnel B2B demand models, lead lifecycle management, and revenue attribution.
  • Experience using marketing automation platforms (HubSpot) and CRM systems (Salesforce).
  • Proven ability to analyze data, identify insights, and translate performance data into optimization actions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with product marketing, sales, and operations teams.

AI & Technical Skills (Must-Have or Strong Plus)

  • Experience leveraging AI-driven features within ad platforms (e.g., automated bidding, audience expansion, responsive ads).
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for keyword research, creative development, performance analysis, and experimentation.
  • Experience with 6sense is a significant plus, including use of intent data, account-based targeting, audience activation, and orchestration of paid media across channels. Candidates with hands-on 6sense experience will be prioritized and moved to the top of the candidate pool.
  • Strong analytical mindset with experience using analytics tools.
  • Working knowledge of conversion tracking, attribution models, and marketing data pipelines.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience marketing HR, payroll, compliance, or SaaS solutions.
  • Familiarity with regulated or compliance-driven industries.
  • Experience supporting multi-solution or portfolio-based marketing strategies.
  • Exposure to conversion rate optimization, landing page optimization, and personalization strategies.

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK.

About Product Management

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The role

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes Grafana Federal Cloud, for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC), which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.

Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.

Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will:

  • Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value against engineering cost and technical constraints
  • Own positioning, messaging, and differentiation for these products, including how they compare to regular Grafana Cloud, and partner with Product Marketing on launches, competitive analysis, enablement, and demand programs
  • Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity
  • Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options
  • Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal to work through product changes affecting our authorization or existing customer commitments

We’re excited about you because you have

  • 5+ years of product management experience on a technical B2B product, or a technical background (software engineering, solutions architecture, SRE, or technical program management) plus a demonstrated move into product ownership
  • Hands-on experience with a non-standard SaaS deployment model, such as self-managed, air-gapped, sovereign, BYOC, single-tenant, or FedRAMP/government cloud, and a firsthand understanding of how it changes the product, its operations, and its economics
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, platform software, or developer tools
  • Clear product and go-to-market judgment: you've shaped what a product should be and how it's positioned and sold, not only when it ships
  • Interest in working with US public sector customers and learning their needs and buying cycles. Deep compliance expertise isn't required.
  • Experience leading across multiple teams without direct authority, with excellent written and verbal communication in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling to or building for US federal, state, or local government customers, or other highly regulated industries
  • Familiarity with government or sovereign cloud frameworks, such as FedRAMP, StateRAMP/GovRAMP, BSI C5, or SecNumCloud, or with offerings such as AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, AWS European Sovereign Cloud, or GCP Sovereign Cloud
  • Experience with pricing and packaging across deployment models
  • Experience with observability, monitoring, or other data-intensive infrastructure products
  • Experience working with resellers, systems integrators, or cloud marketplace partners
  • Familiarity with open source software or commercial open source companies

In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is GBP 117,949- GBP 141,539. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

raw.title: Contract Risk Management Specialist I/II/Sr
raw.excerpt: At EQT, you won't just do a job, you'll help shape our future.
raw.description:
At EQT, you won't just do a job, you'll help shape our future. Through Transparent Leadership, you'll work alongside leaders who value collaboration and ensure every voice is heard. Through Connected Impact, you'll see how your work influences critical business decisions and drives value across our operations. Through Supported Growth, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills through cross-functional collaboration, development opportunities, and career advancement. Join our Qrew!

The Contract Risk Management Specialist I/II/Sr is responsible for the preparation, administration, processing, and maintenance of commercial contracts, amendments, and transaction confirmations. This position ensures contractual documentation is accurate, timely, and compliant with established company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

This role works collaboratively with Commercial, Legal, Credit, Risk, Accounting, and other internal stakeholders to facilitate contract execution, maintain accurate contract records, resolve discrepancies, and support daily commercial operations. This role requires strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

The Contract Risk Management Specialist I/II/Sr responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Contract Administration and Management

  • Prepare, review, process, and maintain commercial contracts, amendments, exhibits, and transaction confirmations in accordance with the Financial Risk and Credit Policy (FRCP), Delegation of Authority (DOA), and established company procedures.
  • Coordinate the internal and external routing, approval, execution, and distribution of contractual documents to ensure timely completion.
  • Process contract name changes, assignments, amendments, and other modifications to existing agreements.
  • Draft and refine contract language as needed, coordinating with Legal to obtain appropriate review and approval of proposed changes.
  • Monitor contract status and follow up with internal stakeholders and counterparties to facilitate timely execution and resolution of outstanding items.
  • Ensure contractual documentation is properly executed, maintained, and accessible in designated contract management systems.

Transaction Confirmations and Compliance

  • Prepare, process, and validate incoming and outgoing transaction confirmations to ensure accuracy and consistency with underlying commercial transactions.
  • Review transaction confirmations for discrepancies and coordinate with Commercial, Risk, Legal, and counterparties to resolve identified issues.
  • Monitor confirmation processing timelines and ensure compliance with applicable policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records of confirmation activity and support internal controls, audit requirements, and compliance reviews.

Systems and Data Management

  • Create, maintain, and update customer and counterparty account records in contract management databases, Salesforce, and Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) systems.
  • Ensure the accuracy and completeness of contract information, customer records, and related documentation across applicable systems.
  • Research and resolve contract data discrepancies, collaborating with internal stakeholders to maintain data integrity.
  • Participate in system testing, enhancements, and implementation activities related to contract management processes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Commercial, Legal, Credit, Risk, Accounting, and other stakeholders to facilitate contract processing and resolve contract-related matters.
  • Provide guidance to Commercial and other internal stakeholders regarding contract documentation requirements, processing procedures, and approval workflows.
  • Respond to contract-related inquiries and provide timely, accurate information to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Retrieve, organize, and compile contracts and supporting documentation in response to requests from Legal, Audit, Accounting, Commercial, and other departments.

Reporting and Process Improvement

  • Prepare and maintain reports identifying contract status, expiration dates, outstanding documentation, and other key contractual information.
  • Maintain and update contract-related procedures, process documentation, and reference materials.
  • Identify opportunities to improve contract administration workflows, data accuracy, and operational efficiency.
  • Participate in departmental projects and cross-functional initiatives involving contract administration, system enhancements, and process improvements.
  • Assist with training and knowledge sharing related to contract procedures, systems, and established policies.

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field preferred, or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in contract administration, commercial operations, energy marketing, or a related business function.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments and competing deadlines.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in contractual documentation and data management.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and external counterparties.
  • Ability to interpret contractual terms, identify discrepancies, and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and work independently within established guidelines.

Preferred Experience and Skills:

  • 4+ years of relevant work experience.
  • JD degree preferred.
  • Familiarity with energy industry contracts, transaction confirmations, and commercial operations is a plus.
  • Experience with Salesforce, ETRM systems, electronic signature platforms, or other contract management applications preferred.

Remote work is being considered for this role excluding the following states: California, Connecticut, Delaware, Illinois, Indiana, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, and Tennessee unless willing to relocate.

Selected incumbent will be placed into the position that best suits their abilities and experience level.

EQT Corporation and its subsidiaries is an Equal Opportunity Employer -- Disabilities/Veterans.

raw.description:
Are you a strategic enterprise seller who thrives on building executive relationships and uncovering growth opportunities in complex organizations?


Do you enjoy helping customers leverage trusted content, data, APIs, and AI-enabled solutions to drive meaningful business outcomes and long-term transformation?


About our Team

Nexis® Solutions, as part of LexisNexis and the global RELX corporate family, connects customers to market-leading data through a flexible suite of scalable solutions, including our award-winning, flagship Nexis® research platform. By enabling fast access to a vast universe of enriched data with intelligent technologies, Nexis Solutions empowers business, media, non-profit, government and academic organizations worldwide to quickly discover actionable insights that enable confident, performance-driving decisions.


About the Role

We are seeking a Strategic Enterprise Relationship Manager to own and strengthen high-priority enterprise relationships within Nexis Solutions. In this role, you will develop trusted executive relationships, build deep account understanding, support adoption and value realization, and help customers achieve measurable business outcomes through long-term strategic partnerships.


You will manage complex enterprise relationships, identify areas for growth, orchestrate internal resources, and position Nexis as a valued long-term partner across key market segments.


Responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts, with accountability for revenue retention, account health, executive engagement, account strategy, opportunity identification, and long-term customer value.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior executives and decision makers, including C-suite leaders, business unit leaders, CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, AI leaders, data leaders, strategy leaders, research leaders, communications leaders, and procurement stakeholders.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans that identify customer priorities, stakeholder maps, whitespace, competitive threats, AI/data use cases, adoption needs, expansion opportunities, and multi-year growth paths.
  • Understand customer needs and use cases, helping customers see how trusted content, data, APIs, and AI-enabled workflows can improve decision-making, productivity, risk management, competitive intelligence, and business performance.
  • Lead consultative, value-based account conversations that connect customer priorities to measurable business outcomes and long-term value.
  • Identify and shape expansion opportunities across business units, functions, geographies, platforms, workflows, and stakeholder groups, partnering with internal teams to advance the most strategic opportunities.
  • Monitor competitive threats, incumbent providers, emerging AI and data vendors, point solutions, and internal-build alternatives, while protecting account position and clearly articulating Nexis’ differentiated value.
  • Lead renewal and account-level commercial discussions, including multi-year agreements, pricing and value conversations, and long-term partnership planning.


Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience owning and growing complex enterprise customer relationships in a strategic account management, enterprise relationship management, or commercially accountable customer success role.
  • Proven ability to protect recurring revenue, strengthen account health, improve adoption and value realization, engage executive stakeholders, mitigate renewal risk, and identify growth opportunities within large, complex customer relationships.
  • Demonstrated success engaging senior executives and complex buying committees across business, technology, data, strategy, procurement, and operational functions.
  • Experience managing enterprise relationships beyond renewal administration, including account planning, stakeholder mapping, adoption improvement, risk mitigation, value realization, executive engagement, and opportunity identification.
  • Strong consultative relationship-management skills, with the ability to connect customer business priorities to differentiated solutions and measurable outcomes.
  • Commercial experience with complex enterprise account cycles, multi-stakeholder negotiations, multi-year agreements, procurement processes, and value-based conversations.


Work in a Way That Works for You

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.


Working Pattern

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.


About the Business

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

raw.excerpt: Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure.
raw.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Principal Strategy Architect to join our team. This is a Remote role within the USA, reporting to the Dir. Strategy Architects in the Strategic Development department. The Principal Strategy Architect partners with Product Management, Worldwide Sales, and Engineering leadership to engage with our most strategic enterprise prospects, customers, and alliance partners. This role is responsible for establishing high-impact technical positioning and executive alignment during the sales cycle, validating architectural fit, and demonstrating how our Zero Trust platform solves complex enterprise security and network transformation challenges. In this role, you will design and deliver executive architectural workshops, drive competitive differentiation, and guide strategic opportunities to successful technical closure.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Drive strategic account revenue by engaging directly with C-level and technical leaders to demonstrate Zscaler’s unique platform value and competitive advantage
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, and Enablement teams to accelerate go-to-market execution, service adoption, and pipeline velocity
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to translate field feedback and customer requirements into strategic initiatives that deliver differentiated value
  • Deliver high-impact customer workshops, internal strategy sessions, and field enablement programs that build repeatable, scalable business growth

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You act like an owner, bringing a strong bias for action and a deep commitment to outcomes, and adapting seamlessly between driving high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who is deeply ambitious for the team’s collective success, actively participating in a challenge culture, and giving and receiving candid, respectful feedback to continuously build trust.
  • You are a purposeful learner with a growth mindset, constantly seeking development and feedback to become a better teammate, and approaching your work with passion, curiosity, and a clear sense of purpose.
  • You are a positive force who approaches complex challenges with constructive energy and a 'can-do' spirit, and inspires colleagues to stay focused on achieving positive outcomes.
  • You are driven by innovation, bringing a deep curiosity to solving complex technical challenges, and believing in technology's power to accelerate transformation and constantly seeking more secure, scalable ways of working.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 10+ years of experience in a solutions architect, engineer, or pre-sales role working for a SASE/SSE vendor partner or a customer
  • Demonstrated ability to develop, execute, and lead cross-departmental collaboration on large, complex SaaS solutions and strategic initiatives
  • Deep understanding of SSE/SASE, security, networking, IaaS, SaaS, and AI technologies
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to speak effectively to technical and executive personas
  • Demonstrated experience developing and enhancing the strategy and tools for the technical sales process and approach

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • Public speaking experience at conference events delivering technical and non-technical content

Zscaler’s salary ranges are benchmarked and are determined by role and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations and could be higher or lower based on a multitude of factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

The base salary range listed for this full-time position excludes commission/ bonus/ equity (if applicable) + benefits.

Base Pay Range

raw.description:
JOB BRIEF

As a Product Owner for the Accounting team at GreenSlate, you will define the solutions to problems identified by the Product Manager, partnering with the PM and engineering to translate those problems into clear user stories, requirements, and a sprint-ready backlog for the development team. You will work daily with developers, QA engineers, and subject matter experts, serving as the primary point of contact for sprint-level questions while building deep expertise in AP entry, payment runs, and bank integrations. Your work will directly shape the accounting experiences that studios, production companies, and content creators rely on, and your ability to turn defined problems into a well-sequenced, sprint-ready backlog will keep our roadmap moving and our platform competitive.

This role is remote within Costa Rica.

WHO WE ARE

GreenSlate is the fastest-growing provider of technology and business solutions for media productions. We provide the most advanced technology for production accounting and entertainment payroll. Our innovative cloud-based platform is evolving the entertainment industry’s back-office by replacing inefficient paper-based processes with digital solutions. The studios, film franchises, independent producers, and content creators we serve benefit from greater efficiencies, better access to data, and cost savings, and they minimize their impact on the environment. GreenSlate offers a full range of payroll, software application, production accounting, tax credit management, ACA compliance & benefits, production insurance, and consulting services. To learn more about the productions we partner with, please visit greenslate.com.

WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

  • Own and groom the product backlog for the Accounting domain, writing clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and definitions of done
  • Partner with the Product Manager and engineering team to define the solution for problems the PM has identified with clients and stakeholders
  • Translate defined problems into sequenced, sprint-ready backlog items in partnership with engineering
  • Partner with subject matter experts and engineering to clarify technical requirements and surface edge cases before work enters a sprint
  • Participate actively in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and sprint review, clarifying priorities and acceptance criteria and accepting or rejecting completed work alongside the Scrum Master
  • Act as the primary point of contact for developers and QA engineers on questions about requirements, edge cases, and acceptance criteria during the sprint
  • Write and maintain detailed specifications covering AP entry, payment runs, bank integrations, and related accounting workflows
  • Validate completed work against acceptance criteria before client-facing release
  • Flag scope, timeline, or solution trade-offs to the Product Manager as they arise during sprint execution
  • Communicate sprint progress, scope changes, and release timing to internal stakeholders and, as needed, clients
  • Own backlog items post-release, prioritizing enhancements and bug fixes in partnership with the Product Manager

WHO YOU ARE

  • 2-5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role in product, entertainment finance, or production accounting
  • Background in accounting or entertainment finance is welcome alongside, or in place of, traditional product experience
  • Experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria and managing a backlog in a tool such as Jira
  • Comfortable owning solution design in partnership with a Product Manager and engineering, translating defined problems into a dev-ready backlog
  • Strong understanding of accounting workflows and terminology, or a demonstrated ability to learn them quickly
  • An excellent communicator who can translate technical and financial complexity for a range of stakeholders
  • Detail-oriented with strong follow-through from requirement to release
  • Customer-oriented and focused on quality customer experiences
  • A skilled collaborator, working with people at all levels of the company
  • You are interested in developing an in-depth knowledge of the production accounting and payroll industry

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US (Costa Rica)

  • Compensation that reflects your value: Competitive salary packages tailored to your experience with opportunities for regular reviews and raises
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Benefits that go beyond the basics, including private medical and life insurance, psychological support, English program, wellness discounts and perks through the Holisticly platform.
  • Full-Time Remote Flexibility: Enjoy working remotely with all the tools and support needed to stay connected and productive
  • Impactful Work: Be part of projects that make a difference in the entertainment industry, with a direct influence on shaping our future and making tangible change
  • A Thriving, Collaborative Culture: Join a team that values open communication and creativity. Quality, Urgency, Innovation, Service, and Collaboration drive everything we do backed by access to leading AI tools so you can work smarter, not harder

The physical demands that are described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to hear and see. The employee is regularly required to stand and sit/ The employee is regularly required to practice manual dexterity sufficient to operate standard office equipment. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and distant vision. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is exposed to standard office equipment. Occasionally called upon to work hours in excess of the normal daily schedule. The employee may need the ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

GreenSlate is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a fair and inclusive workplace. In accordance with Article 404 of the Costa Rican Labor Code, we do not discriminate based on age, race, ethnicity, sex, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic under Costa Rican law.

GreenSlate is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable Costa Rican legislation.

At GreenSlate, we take steps to protect applicants from online fraud and scams. We never ask applicants for credit card information, bank account details, or payments for training or fees during the recruitment process. We encourage applicants to verify recruitment communications before sharing sensitive information.
