Senior Director, Media Sales & Brand Partnerships

Big Think Media | Remote (New York-Based Candidates Only)

About Big Think Media

So much of media today feels small. Optimized for short attention spans, hot takes, and fleeting trends. At Big Think Media, we believe the world deserves something better and we're building the world's biggest platform for the world's biggest thinkers.

Our flagship publication, Big Think, reaches millions of readers and viewers through original journalism, in-depth interviews, newsletters, video, and a premium quarterly print magazine. We cover the ideas shaping science, technology, business, philosophy, and culture.

We're guided by four values: curious, thoughtful, open, and constructive. We believe great ideas deserve serious attention, that complex questions rarely have simple answers, and that media can help people better understand the world.

We're looking for people who share those beliefs and care about these ides too.

The Opportunity

We're hiring a Senior Director, Media Sales & Brand Partnerships to grow our editorial sponsorship business with direct-to-brand enterprise clients and media agencies. This is a high-energy hunting role which demands outstanding communication, ruthless prioritization, a sharp read on partner business priorities paired with creative problem-solving, and proven lead development.

What You’ll Do

Build and close major partnerships

  • Report directly to the General Manager and work closely with them to grow this business
  • Own the full sales cycle on $100k-$500k+ opportunities, from identifying prospects and developing relationships to pitching, negotiating, and closing deals.
  • Own a personal revenue target and be responsible for achieving quarterly and annual sales goals
  • Work closely with internal teams to develop comprehensive sales proposals

Help define our go-to-market strategy

  • Develop a clear point of view on which industries, brands, agencies, and decision-makers represent our strongest opportunities.
  • Identify the most effective ways to generate new business, whether through direct outreach, agency relationships, strategic networking, RFPs, or other approaches.
  • Bring market intelligence back to the team to inform our sponsorship offerings, positioning, and commercial strategy.

Who You Are

  • An experienced premium media seller. At least 5 years of experience is required. You have a successful track record selling high-value sponsorships, integrated media partnerships, or custom programs at a respected publisher or editorial media company.
  • A proven seller. You've personally developed and closed six-figure partnerships with major brands and have achieved targets north of $1.5M annually.
  • A strategic business developer. You know how to identify the right prospects, reach decision-makers, build relationships, and create opportunities rather than simply waiting for inbound demand.
  • Well connected or exceptionally good at getting connected. You understand the agency and brand marketing landscape and know how major media investments get made.
  • An excellent storyteller. You can communicate the value of an editorial brand, develop persuasive proposals, and connect ideas to business objectives.
  • Commercially ambitious and intellectually curious. You care about winning business, but you're also genuinely interested in the ideas, people, and conversations that define Big Think.
  • An independent operator. You're comfortable owning your pipeline, setting priorities, and working in an entrepreneurial environment with significant autonomy.
  • A person with good judgment. You understand that the best editorial partnerships create value for brands without compromising the integrity of the publication.

What You’ll Get

  • Join a supportive, collaborative team with opportunities to grow in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comprehensive wellness benefits: memberships to HealthAdvocate, Teladoc, OneMedical, and Talkspace.
  • Competitive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability coverage, 401(k), and more!

Location: Remote, but candidates must be based in NY.

Compensation: Competitive base salary plus performance-based commission, with target total compensation of approximately $250,000 annually. Final compensation will depend on experience and the agreed commission structure.

Interested?

We'd love to hear about the major partnerships you've built, how you approach developing new business, and why Big Think's mission resonates with you.

About Radformation

Radformation specializes in Radiation Oncology workflow automation. Our solutions save clinics time, eliminate planning errors, and enable the design of optimal treatments for patients. Our software focuses on three key areas:
  • Time savings through automation
  • Error reduction through automated systems
  • Increased quality care through advanced algorithms and workflows
We are a fully remote, mission-driven team united by a shared goal: to reduce cancer’s global impact and help save more of the 10 million lives it claims each year. Every line of code, every product release, and every conversation with our customers brings us closer to ensuring no patient’s treatment quality depends on where they live.

Why this role matters
We are looking for a highly motivated individual who has a passion for treatment planning and enjoys a non-stop busy day. The Clinical Success Manager will bring their upbeat personality to this role to provide training to clinics, solve problems on the fly with customers, and proactively call clinics to ensure satisfaction with their purchase.

The Clinical Success Manager will mentor clinics as they join the Radformation community, helping them establish the most efficient workflows and improve safety. As the Clinical Success Manager, you will develop relationships with clinics and incorporate feedback into creating clinics’ dream products. With your clinical background, you can teach and improve efficiency in Radiation Oncology clinics nationwide.

The working hours for this role will be 8am - 5pm PT

Responsibilities include:

  • Train clinics on Radformation’s suite of automation tools
  • Work with clinics to understand their issues and provide a solution independently and/or with the help of the programming team
  • Proactively check in with current customers to perform an annual Rad Review to hear feedback for product improvement, share new features, ensure their subscription renewal/reduce churn, and strengthen our relationship with them
  • Host webinars to answer clinics’ questions and highlight features
  • Test new versions of software to aid in development and quality assurance
  • Develop training materials to distribute to clinics

Required Experience:

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in clinical dosimetry using Eclipse TPS
  • Strong critical thinking skills
  • Exceptional presentation skills
  • Positive attitude and a passion for excellence in patient care

Preferred Experience:

  • 5 years of experience in clinical dosimetry using Eclipse TPS
  • Teaching experience in dosimetry
  • Customer service experience

Abilities:

  • Passionate about helping other clinics and creating an impact on their workflow
  • Enthusiastic about learning new technologies and sharing them with the healthcare community
  • Thrives in a busy schedule and a constant learning environment
  • Excels at multitasking and managing multiple projects simultaneously
  • Enjoys listening to clinics’ needs and developing relationships with clinical leaders
  • Master of treatment planning and radiation oncology clinical workflow
  • Ability to maintain a positive attitude in a fast-paced and ever-changing work environment
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral
  • Non-judgmental personality and welcoming of ideas and feedback

Benefits & Perks — What Makes Us RAD

We care about our people as much as we care about our mission. We offer competitive compensation, benefits, and the opportunity to make an impact in the fight against cancer.

For US teammates (via TriNet):

Health & Wellness

  • Multiple high-quality medical plan options with substantial employer contributions toward premiums, often covering the full cost depending on the plan selected.
  • Health coverage starting on day one
  • Short-term and long-term disability and supplementary life insurance

Financial & Professional Growth

  • 401(k) with employer match vested immediately
  • Annual reimbursement for professional memberships
  • Conference attendance and continued learning opportunities

Work-Life Balance & Perks

  • Self-managed PTO and 10 paid holidays
  • Monthly internet stipend
  • Company-issued laptop and one-time home office setup stipend
  • Fully remote work environment with virtual events and yearly retreats, because we like to have fun while doing work that matters

For global teammates (via Deel):At Radformation, we want every team member to feel supported, no matter where they live. For teammates outside the US, we provide benefits that align with local laws and standards, working with our Employer of Record (EOR) partners to ensure fairness and equity. This means your benefits package will be locally compliant, competitive, and designed to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Cancer affects people from every walk of life, and we believe our team should reflect that diversity. Radformation is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and are committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees.

Agency & Candidate Safety Notice

Radformation does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies without a signed agreement in place. We do not partner with third-party recruiters unless explicitly stated. All legitimate communication from Radformation will come from an @radformation.com email address. If you receive outreach from another domain or via unofficial channels, please contact .

AI & Hiring Integrity

At Radformation we believe AI can be an incredible tool for innovation, but our hiring process is all about getting to know you, your skills, experience, and unique approach to problem solving. We ask that all interviews and assessments be completed without tools that generate answers in real time. This helps ensure a fair process for everyone and allows us to see your authentic work. Using such tools during the process may affect your candidacy.

AI Applications Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: AI Applications Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (United States)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$175,000 Annually
Experience: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are looking for an AI Applications Engineer to design, execute, and operationalize fine-tuning workflows for large language models across supervised, preference-based, and reinforcement learning approaches. The role requires deep practical experience with modern training stacks, careful dataset construction, rigorous evaluation methodology, and the engineering discipline to operate complex training pipelines reliably. The ideal candidate combines strong ML intuition with production-grade engineering practices, and is comfortable navigating the trade-offs between data quality, compute budget, evaluation rigor, and shipping velocity. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications
  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
  • Six or more years of combined ML research and engineering experience, with significant LLM exposure.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks, especially PyTorch.
  • Hands-on experience fine-tuning transformer-based language models at non-trivial scale.
  • Familiarity with distributed training strategies including FSDP, ZeRO, and pipeline parallelism.
  • Experience with RLHF, DPO, or other preference optimization techniques.
  • Strong understanding of evaluation methodology, benchmarks, and human evaluation design.
  • Experience operating training jobs on GPU clusters and recovering from failures.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Track record of shipping or publishing impactful LLM work.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Publications at top-tier ML venues.
  • Experience with multimodal model fine-tuning.
  • Familiarity with synthetic data generation and dataset distillation.
  • Open-source contributions to LLM training libraries.
  • Exposure to responsible AI evaluation and red-teaming practices.

How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to  or contact us at (908) 505-3545. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at .

raw.description:
Systems & Software, a division of Harris; is seeking a Project Manager

Systems and Software (www.ssivt.com), a division of Harris Computer Systems, is a software development company headquartered in Winooski, VT. S&S's single focus is on delivering horizontally and vertically scalable customer service solutions to the utility industry. Our reputation is one of market-leading software, exceptional solution delivery, and a customer-focused organization.

For a utility, a Customer Information System (CIS) is more than just a collection of records, it's a lifeline between the utility and its most important asset, its customers. From turn-on to move-out, no other system will have the impact on the customer experience that the CIS does, so ensuring that this solution offers the breadth of scope and responsiveness that modern consumers require is a critical priority. Through our flagship product, enQuesta, S&S meets this need for our electric, water, sewer and gas customers by combining an intuitive design with powerful technology. The enQuesta solution not only presents a modern, innovative face for the utility to the end customers, but also enables the utilities to take advantage of the solution's open architecture when developing future programs and initiatives.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 75%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean. This opportunity can be performed remotely or from our office in Winooski, VT. Travel, depending on the project(s).

Salary:

80K - 100K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

What your impact will be:

Project Coordination & Management

  • Coordinate components of utility CIS software implementation projects, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
  • Maintain and update detailed project plans, timelines, and budgets to ensure projects remain on track.
  • Identify and report issues, risks, or delays in a timely manner to the PMO Manager and stakeholders for resolution.
  • Provide clear communication and regular updates on project progress to the PMO Manager and project teams.

Process Support & Standardization

  • Assist the PMO Manager in maintaining project management documentation and processes to ensure consistency across projects.
  • Adhere to established project management methodologies, including Waterfall and Agile, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with project management practices and help identify areas for administrative efficiency.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Maintain consistent communication with internal teams, including R&D, Sales, and Delivery, to ensure alignment on project tasks.

Financial Tracking & Reporting

  • Assist in monitoring project budgets, ensuring expenses are tracked against financial goals.
  • Track and report on project status, timelines, and financials, generating regular status reports for the PMO Manager.
  • Collaborate with finance teams to verify financial data aligns with forecasts.

Performance Monitoring

  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as project delivery timelines and budget variance.
  • Assist in analyzing project execution data to contribute ideas for enhancing team efficiency.
  • Support the PMO Manager in preparing project status updates and gathering data for issue escalation.
  • Participate in client-facing discussions, documenting meeting minutes and action items to ensure customer satisfaction.

What we are looking for:

  • 1-3 years of experience in project management or a related role, preferably within software implementations or technical environments.
  • Experience in managing project budgets ranging from $10k to over $2.5M.
  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Jira, Spira, Confluence, SharePoint, and Clarizen.
  • Basic understanding of Waterfall project management; exposure to Agile methodologies is a plus.
  • Experience tracking project financials or budgets is preferred.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with team members and customers.
  • Ability to work collaboratively and manage tasks with guidance.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities with a focus on learning and delivering results.
  • Experience working in a team-oriented environment, collaborating with cross-functional groups such as Sales, R&D, and Delivery.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on organization and process.
  • Position may require travel as high as 75% in North America without restriction.
  • Frequent communication through Teams, phone calls, and email to stay connected with remote teams and leadership.

What we can offer:

  • 3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
  • Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
  • Lifestyle rewards
  • Remote work and more!

About Systems & Software:

Systems & Software, a subsidiary of Harris Computer and part of Constellation Software, has been serving utilities and municipalities since 1973. Headquartered in Vermont, the company provides the enQuesta CIS platform to manage billing and utility operations for electric, water, gas, wastewater, solid waste, and property taxes. Our solutions enable utilities to manage complex rate structures, streamline operations, and enhance customer service, all without the need for custom code or disconnected systems. With cloud-based deployment, SOC 2 Type II certification, and interoperability with meter data systems, GIS, and financial tools, Systems & Software delivers stability, security, and flexibility that utilities can trust. Our commitment to ongoing investment ensures continuous innovation and a strong partnership with our customers across North America.

About Harris:

Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Harris will continue to growth through reinvestment – both in the people and products that we offer and making investments in acquiring new businesses.

raw.description:
For the longest time, banking* has only really served one purpose, holding money securely. In doing so, it’s also slowed us down and overcomplicated things. That’s where Mercury comes in. Banking should do more and we’re on a mission to make that happen through powerful banking solutions and simplifying all of the financial workflows that come with managing a business. To accomplish this end, we also need to ensure the trust and safety of our customers, partners and ecosystem. Thankfully, Mercury has a world class Risk team to detect and mitigate any threats. And this team is growing. We’re looking to bring on a Risk User Experience Specialist to make risk decisions in response to risk-related user inquiries, all while providing best-in-class user experiences.

As a Risk User Experience Specialist, you’ll be responsible for responding to transaction limit request increases, making risk decisions on queued payments and check deposits, and leveraging your general risk knowledge to escalate unusual or high risk behavior to relevant teams. You’ll be responsible for providing great user experiences to Mercury users while making highly efficient and high quality risk assessments. You will report directly to the Risk User Experience Lead and will be supported by a highly functional team.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Schedule Information:

Required: This position requires you to be able to work on the weekends in addition to weekdays

  • This position will be full time working Sunday - Thursday shift, with standard working hours (8am-5pm local time)
  • Your working schedule will be fixed - this is not a rotating shift

Here are some things you’ll do on the job:

  • Respond to limit request increases from high and moderate risk users, while reviewing account and transactional activity, to determine if aligned with expected account usage
  • Review Overlimit transactions through a dedicated queue, evaluating account history and risk signals, and requesting supporting documentation as needed, to approve or reject within required cutoff times
  • Review and decision remote check deposits submitted by users utilizing internal tools, and third party systems
  • Manage a high-volume caseload within service level agreements and with critical attention to detail
  • Respond to Risk support requests in the mailbox and Slack channels, related to limit increases, and other account operations inquiries from financial partners, users, or other internal/external parties
  • Partner with our BPO team by providing second opinions and exception guidance on escalated reviews for both check deposits and overlimit transactions
  • Document rationale for risk decisions with supporting documentation
  • Write clear documentation on current processes and help train future teammates
  • Identify opportunities to make processes more observable, scalable, and efficient through tooling changes and procedure updates
  • Maintain a positive user experience, while mitigating any potential fraud loss or risk to Mercury

You should:

  • Have experience working in banking, fintech, or other financial services
  • Have 2-3 years of experience working in the risk space
  • Have product sense and knowledge of banking products (e.g., ACH, International Wires, SWIFT, checks, and debit card)
  • Exercise empathy and understanding when communicating with users
  • Manage relationships with external parties with confidence and kindness
  • Act as a generalist by assessing various types of risk when making decisions
  • Work with efficiency and focus
  • Write with clarity and purpose
  • Prioritize requests and keep track of follow-ups
  • Love problem solving and making teams, products, and processes more efficient

Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

Total Rewards
The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.

Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role are the following:

US employees in New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area:
$75,900—$85,400 USD
US employees outside of New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area:
$68,300—$76,900 USD

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking Sales Managers to join our passionate, high energy, and fast moving sales team. You’ll lead and support our Account Executives II focusing on mid-sized Private Sector organizations. You will have a consistent track record of ability to hire, develop, and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team.

This is a remote position open to candidates living in the US Pacific/Mountain Time Zone. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this position.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.

Click here to learn about what we value at Samsara.

In this role, you will:

  • Coach a team of ~8 account executives on sales strategy, pipeline reviews and achieve quarterly targets
  • Hire new account executives and provide both onboarding and ongoing coaching to ensure their growth and success
  • Work cross-functionally to strategically solve problems and project manage
  • Create content for ongoing training and development
  • Support account executives through professional development plans
  • Provide clear and tactical feedback to account executives
  • Further culture within the team and commercial organization with high emotional intelligence
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • At least two years of proven leadership performance
  • Strong track record of overachievement with experience in coaching a team on outbounding
  • Understanding of complex sales cycles involving multiple decision makers, multiple products, and extended time-frames
  • Excellent communication skills and comfortable with public speaking
  • Strong interpersonal and team management skills
  • Self-starter and adaptable to change
  • Continued growth mindset to learn a unique industry
  • Proven proficiency in data driven decision making in current role
  • Demonstrated ability to provide upwards feedback to upper management
  • Showcased ability to analyze and accurately forecast existing pipeline
  • Comfort working with cross functional teams
  • Proficient in utilizing tools such as SFDC, SalesLoft, Gong

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that OTE pay may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$176,460—$259,500 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

raw.description:
Our client, a rapidly growing Amazon FBM (Fulfilled by Merchant) business sourcing a wide range of products from China, is looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Inventory Manager to support the companys focus on fast fulfillment, operational efficiency, and data-driven decision-making. In this role, they will be responsible for overseeing all inventory operations, from procurement and inbound logistics to spare parts control and returns processing. A major part of the position involves building and maintaining advanced data systems and dashboards in Google Sheets, ensuring accurate stock visibility and operational efficiency across all channels.

About the company:

The company is an e-commerce brand built around movement, energy, and family fun. Best known for its high-quality outdoor products - especially trampolines designed for safety and joy - it is growing fast across global marketplaces. The company values initiative, quality, and people who take ownership of their work. If youre passionate about e-commerce and want to play a key role in building something meaningful, you might be a great fit.

Key responsibilities:

Inventory & Stock Control

  • Maintain accurate and real-time stock levels for all SKUs across Amazon FBM channels and internal databases.
  • Develop and maintain Google Sheets dashboards to track inventory, shipments, returns, and reorder points.
  • Monitor spare parts inventory, ensuring correct allocation and timely replenishment.
  • Forecast inventory needs based on sales trends and product lifecycle data.
  • Prevent stockouts and overstock through precise data-driven planning.

Procurement & Supplier Coordination

  • Coordinate purchase orders and shipping schedules with suppliers in China.
  • Track inbound shipments and lead times using structured data sheets.
  • Follow up with suppliers and freight forwarders on delays, discrepancies, or quality issues.
  • Support cost analysis and order optimization using spreadsheet models.

Returns & Reverse Logistics

  • Manage returns and spare parts processing, including inspection, refurbishment, restocking, or disposal.
  • Update stock and status in Google Sheets and inventory systems in real time.
  • Optimize workflows for handling returned goods efficiently.

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Build automated reports in Google Sheets with formulas, pivot tables, charts, and scripts (e.g., Apps Script or integrations).
  • Track KPIs such as stock accuracy, turnover rates, aging inventory, and reorder performance.
  • Identify inefficiencies and propose data-backed improvements.
  • Collaborate with other departments to provide clear inventory visibility and forecasts.

Process & System Optimization

  • Integrate data between Google Sheets, Amazon Seller Central, and warehouse systems.
  • Standardize inventory tracking templates and ensure all team members follow consistent data procedures.
  • Support automation initiatives to reduce manual work.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience as an Inventory Manager, Supply Chain Manager, or similar role in Amazon FBM and FBA.
  • Expert-level Google Sheets skills: Data visualization and reporting
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Experience managing spare parts, returns, or similar technical products.
  • Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central and FBM workflows.
  • Experience working with Chinese suppliers and freight forwarders.
  • Excellent English communication skills.
  • Experience integrating Google Sheets with other tools (e.g., Zapier, APIs, or ERP systems).
  • Knowledge of 3PL operations and warehouse management.
  • Understanding of international shipping and import processes
  • Strong process mindset and ability to build SOPs.

What We Offer:

  • Work for a Market-proven, fast-growing company.
  • Competitive salary and bonus opportunities
  • Supportive work environment.
  • Friendly International start-up environment.
  • Self-development trainings and courses.
  • Be a part of something bigger, where you can have autonomy over your work.

Job Description:

The Senior Technical Project Manager – Enterprise Technology & Systems Delivery is a project delivery leader within the PMO organization responsible for managing technology programs and enterprise transformation initiatives across multiple workstreams. This role drives delivery from initiation through go-live and stabilization, ensuring tight schedule management, strong cross-functional coordination, proactive risk and issue escalation, and disciplined governance throughout the project lifecycle.

The role requires someone who can understand technical concepts, dependencies, and delivery risks well enough to coordinate effectively across engineering, infrastructure, integration, data, and testing teams, but who is not expected to serve as the hands-on technical lead or provide technical solution ownership. Success is defined by on-time execution, stakeholder alignment, effective governance, and sustainable adoption of technology-enabled change.

What you'll do:

  • Lead end-to-end project management for technology implementations, platform migrations, system integrations, and transformation initiatives from charter through go-live and hypercare.
  • Manage multiple concurrent workstreams, integrating business, engineering, infrastructure, data, testing, and change activities into a single executable project plan.
  • Build and maintain detailed schedules, milestone plans, RAID logs, dependency trackers, RACI matrices, and status reporting.
  • Coordinate closely with business stakeholders, IT and engineering teams, systems integrators, and vendor partners to ensure alignment on scope, timing, deliverables, and decisions.
  • Facilitate planning, requirements, design, and workstream checkpoint sessions with technical leads and business process owners.
  • Support governance routines, including workstream meetings, status reviews, and escalation paths; help prepare materials for steering committees and leadership updates.
  • Identify, track, and escalate risks, issues, decisions, and dependencies through the project governance structure with urgency and clarity.
  • Ensure the project schedule is actively managed and tightly driven, including follow-up on overdue actions, management of critical path items, and resolution of cross-workstream blockers.
  • Coordinate technical and non-technical delivery activities across integrations, infrastructure, data migration, testing, cutover, and deployment, without acting as the technical authority for solution design.
  • Support budget tracking, forecast updates, and variance reporting where applicable.
  • Lead preparation for SIT, UAT, cutover, and go-live readiness activities in partnership with the appropriate SMEs and delivery leads.
  • Support organizational change management, communications, training coordination, and adoption planning with business and OCM partners.
  • Track vendor and systems integrator delivery performance against plans and milestones.
  • Prepare clear status updates, decision summaries, and risk reports for project leadership.

Required qualifications:

  • 3+ years of project management experience, including 2+ years leading technology implementation or integration projects.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technical programs (e.g., software platform implementations, infrastructure or cloud migrations, system integrations, or enterprise application rollouts).
  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously while maintaining a tightly controlled integrated schedule and clear accountability across teams.
  • Solid understanding of technology delivery lifecycles, including planning, design, build, test, data migration, cutover, go-live, and stabilization.
  • Ability to understand technical concepts, integration dependencies, environment readiness, data migration risks, and testing implications sufficiently to coordinate teams and drive delivery, without being the primary technical resource.
  • Strong command of project management fundamentals including scope management, schedule management, RAID management, dependency tracking, status reporting, and governance.
  • Experience working with stakeholders across business, IT, and vendor organizations.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and organizational skills, with the ability to drive action and elevate issues clearly and promptly.
  • CAPM, PMP, or equivalent certification is a plus.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience within a PMO or technology delivery team supporting cross-functional programs.
  • Experience managing technical workstreams across domains such as cloud infrastructure, data & analytics, DevOps/engineering, cybersecurity, or digital/customer platforms.
  • Background in technology transformation, including migration from legacy platforms and coordination of business process change.
  • Exposure to enterprise governance practices, such as steering committee reporting and structured escalation management.
  • Familiarity with organizational change management frameworks and enterprise adoption planning.
  • Prior experience as a business analyst, technical lead, or systems power user is helpful, particularly where that experience improves communication with technical and business teams.

We're looking for a Director of Engineering to set the technical strategy for Data Labs, the team that builds the benchmarking systems, data pipelines, and RL environments behind our AI training engagements. The frontier labs and enterprises we work with are changing how they train, evaluate, and deploy models every quarter. Your job is to see where that market is going and make sure Data Labs is built for it before our clients ask.

You'll decide which capabilities we invest in, which we standardize into platform, and which we leave to individual engagements. You'll track how training methods, evaluation practices, and data needs are shifting across the industry, and turn that into a technical roadmap and a point of view our commercial and research teams can sell against.

You'll lead a group of engineering managers, forward deployed engineers (FDEs), and senior ICs, and partner closely with applied research, product, and go-to-market leadership. This is a hands-on strategic role. You won't spend much time writing code, but you'll stay close enough to the technical work to make and defend hard architectural calls, and close enough to clients to know which calls matter.

What You'll Do

Technical Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the multi-year technical strategy for Data Labs, and translate it into a roadmap tied to where the AI training and evaluation market is heading.
  • Decide where to build shared platform versus engagement-specific solutions, weighing reuse against team autonomy so platforms speed teams up rather than creating over-dependency.
  • Set architectural direction for benchmarking infrastructure, data pipelines, and RL environments so they stay reproducible, portable across client deployments, and ready for the next generation of training methods.
  • Anticipate technical shifts 6–18 months out, such as new post-training techniques, agentic evaluation, and synthetic data, and place the bets that keep Invisible ahead of them.
  • Set expectations for how AI is used in design reviews and day-to-day engineering work.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Positioning

  • Build a clear, current view of how frontier labs and enterprises are training, evaluating, and deploying models, and what that means for the data and infrastructure they'll need from us.
  • Track the competitive landscape across AI data, evaluation, and RL environment providers, and help define where Invisible differentiates.
  • Turn client signals, research developments, and market trends into investment recommendations for executive leadership.
  • Partner with product and commercial teams to shape new offerings, pricing logic, and the technical story behind them.

Evaluation & Data Strategy

  • Define Invisible's point of view on benchmarking and evaluation, including pre- and post-engagement comparisons, capability gap analyses, and regression tracking.
  • Make sure evaluation design ties to client-defined success metrics, validate automated checks against human judgment, and be explicit about what each approach can't see.
  • Identify reusable data assets, frameworks, and pipelines that become durable advantages and improve margins across engagements.
  • Shape practices for data licensing, privacy, and contamination risk as a strategic differentiator, not just a compliance requirement.

Client & Executive Engagement

  • Represent engineering in executive conversations, strategic client relationships, and pre-sales, translating technical reality into clear, honest narratives.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to client research and engineering leaders, bringing back what you learn to inform the roadmap.
  • Help leaders weigh client-specific asks against broader platform and business goals, with clear short- and long-term paths.

Organizational Leadership

  • Lead and grow an engineering org of multiple teams, including engineering managers, senior managers, FDEs, and Staff+ ICs.
  • Coach managers to build sound technical judgment and strategic awareness in their teams.
  • Build hiring pipelines that reinforce a rigorous, client-focused, strategy-aware engineering culture.
  • Make sure the org has the planning, quality, and operational practices it needs to execute on the strategy reliably, delegating day-to-day delivery to strong managers.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with significant experience building ML or AI systems.
  • 5+ years in engineering leadership, including experience managing managers across multiple teams.
  • A track record of setting multi-year technical strategy and making platform investment decisions that paid off commercially.
  • Deep, current understanding of the AI training and evaluation landscape, including how frontier labs and enterprises approach fine-tuning, RLHF/RLAIF, and evaluation methodology.
  • Hands-on familiarity with LLM training pipelines, deep enough to make and defend architectural decisions.
  • Experience building benchmarking, data curation, or RL infrastructure that produced measurable client outcomes.
  • Ability to read market and competitive signals and turn them into a technical roadmap and a clear product point of view.
  • Strong cross-functional partnership with applied research, product, and commercial teams.
  • Excellent executive communication, and confidence acting as a technical advisor in client and pre-sales conversations.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience at an AI services firm, applied research consultancy, frontier lab, or enterprise AI product company.
  • A visible point of view on the AI data and evaluation market, such as talks, writing, or open-source work.
  • Familiarity with data licensing, synthetic data generation, or contamination detection involving client data.
  • Experience shaping new product lines or service offerings from a technical foundation.
  • Experience leading an org through rapid growth or significant change.

What’s In It For You

Invisible is committed to fair and competitive pay, ensuring that compensation reflects both market conditions and the value each team member brings. Our salary structure accounts for regional differences in cost of living while maintaining internal equity.

For this position, the annual salary will include a 20% annual bonus and an additional incentive structure. The base salary range for SF/NY are:

Salary Range
$252,000—$300,000 USD

You can find more information about our geographic pay tiers here. During the interview process, your Invisible Talent Acquisition Partner will confirm which tier applies to your location. For candidates outside the U.S., compensation is adjusted to reflect local market conditions and cost of living.

*Bonuses and equity are included in all full-time offers. Final compensation is determined by a combination of factors, including location, job-related experience, skills, knowledge, internal pay equity, and overall market conditions. Because of this, every offer is unique. Additional details on total compensation and benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

What It's Like to Work at Invisible:

At Invisible, we’re not just redefining work—we’re reinventing it. We operate at the intersection of advanced AI and human ingenuity, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible to unlock productivity and scale. Ownership is at the core of everything we do. Here, you won’t just execute tasks—you’ll build, innovate, and shape the future alongside world-class clients pushing the boundaries of AI.

We expect bold ideas, relentless drive, and the ability to turn ambiguity into opportunity. The pace is fast, the challenges are big, and the growth is unmatched. We’re not for everyone, and we’re okay with that. If you’re looking for predictable routines, this isn’t the place for you. But if you’re driven to create, thrive in dynamic environments, and want a front-row seat to the AI revolution, you’ll fit right in.

While some roles may offer remote flexibility, most positions involve in-office collaboration and are tied to specific locations. • Rôle d'artiste technique, nécessitant des connaissances de base en gréement et en script Python.
  • Capacité à écrire des scripts/outils Maya/Mobu robustes et prendre directement en charge les pipelines interdisciplinaires.

  • Doit être capable de s'épanouir dans un environnement axé sur les outils où l'automatisation, la réutilisabilité et l'évolutivité sont essentielles.
  • Une communication efficace est requise : vous devez valider les pipelines directement dans les jeux sans assistance.
  • Doit être capable de trouver le juste équilibre entre qualité et évolutivité pour tous les archétypes et la conversion des actifs existants.
  • Maintenir la direction artistique et la qualité des matériaux, des nuanceurs et des ressources.
  • Créer les matériaux définitifs pour les personnages, les environnements et les effets; prendre en charge les systèmes de matériaux existants.
  • Développer des flux de travail et des pipelines efficaces pour soutenir les équipes artistiques et de conception.
  • Effectuer des recherches et mettre en place de nouvelles techniques afin d'améliorer la qualité et les performances des actifs.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes d'art, d'animation, de conception et d'ingénierie afin de résoudre les problèmes liés au pipeline et aux actifs.
  • Proposer des outils et des pipelines d'automatisation pour l'itération, l'optimisation et les flux de travail procéduraux.
  • Déboguer et profiler les ressources pour garantir les performances sur toutes les plateformes.
  • Fournir des commentaires techniques, de la documentation et encadrer d'autres artistes.
  • Tech artist role, requiring some basic rigging knowledge and Python scripting.
  • Ability to write robust Maya/Mobu tools/scripts and directly support cross-discipline pipelines.
  • Expected to interface frequently with stakeholders, guiding conversations around rigging, shaders, and workflows. Proactive in surfacing risks and raising solutions early.
  • Needs to thrive in a tool-driven environment where automation, reusability, and scale are essential.
  • Strong communication required: must validate pipelines directly in game builds without hand-holding.
  • Should be comfortable balancing quality with scalability across archetypes and legacy asset conversion
  • Maintain artistic direction and quality across materials, shaders, and assets.
  • Create final materials for characters, environments, and effects; support existing material systems.
  • Develop efficient workflows and pipelines to support art and design teams.
  • Research and implement new techniques to improve quality and performance of assets.
  • Collaborate closely with Art, Animation, Design, and Engineering to resolve pipeline and asset issues.
  • Propose tools and automation pipelines for iteration, optimization, and procedural workflows.
  • Debug and profile assets to ensure performance across platforms.
  • Provide technical feedback, documentation, and mentoring for other artists.
  • Un portefeuille solide présentant des travaux de qualité AAA dans le domaine des moteurs (propriétaires, Unreal ou Unity).
  • Une excellente connaissance des outils de création de contenu numérique standard de l'industrie (Maya, ZBrush, Substance Painter/Designer, Photoshop ou équivalents).
  • Maîtrise du langage de script Python (PyQt/PySide), avec la capacité d'écrire un code propre, réutilisable et facile à maintenir.
  • À l'aise avec la création de nouveaux plugiciels Maya/moteur, l'écriture de pipelines extensibles et la conversion de formats hérités vers des formats modernes.
  • Prend en charge l'automatisation dans les pipelines de reciblage, de recalcul des matériaux, de tessellation et d'optimisation des maillages.
  • Passionné par les techniques de rendu modernes et les flux de travail procéduraux ; à l'aise avec le débogage des nuanceurs, l'héritage et le profilage du temps d'exécution.
  • Bonne connaissance des langages de nuanceurs (HLSL/GLSL) et des techniques de rendu.
  • Compréhension des mathématiques 3D, des meilleures pratiques en matière de topologie, des flux de travail de théories du rendu physique et des stratégies d'optimisation.
  • Solides compétences en matière de résolution de problèmes et d'analyse.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en matière de communication, de collaboration et de mentorat.
  • Plus de 3 ans d'expérience dans le secteur avec au moins un titre commercialisé.
  • La maîtrise de l'anglais est une exigence du poste, compte tenu des interactions régulières avec nos intervenants et partenaires situés hors Québec.

Un Atout:

  • Expérience avec Houdini, MotionBuilder ou d'autres outils procéduraux.
  • Connaissance approfondie du langage C++ et du développement de plugiciels Maya/OpenMaya.
  • Connaissance des pipelines de rendu modernes, des systèmes de particules, des simulations de tissus/physique et de l'éclairage.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing AAA-quality work in engine (proprietary, Unreal, or Unity).
  • Excellent knowledge of industry-standard DCC tools (Maya, ZBrush, Substance Painter/Designer, Photoshop, or equivalents).
  • Proficiency in Python scripting (PyQt/PySide), with ability to write clean, reusable, maintainable code.
  • Comfortable building new Maya/engine plug-ins, writing extensible pipelines, and bridging legacy → modern formats.
  • Supports automation in retargeting, material rebaking, tessellation, and mesh optimization pipelines.
  • Enthusiastic about modern rendering techniques and procedural workflows; comfortable debugging shaders, inheritance, and profiling runtime.
  • Good knowledge of shader languages (HLSL/GLSL) and rendering techniques.
  • Understanding of 3D math, topology best practices, PBR workflows, and optimization strategies.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.
  • 3+ years industry experience with at least one shipped title.
  • Proficiency in English is required for this position, as the role involves regular communication with international colleagues, partners, and stakeholders based outside of Québec.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Houdini, MotionBuilder, or other procedural tools.
  • Familiarity with C++ and Maya/OpenMaya plugin development.
  • Knowledge of modern rendering pipelines, particle systems, cloth/physics simulations, and lighting.

Ce que nous offrons:

People Can Fly est l'un des principaux studios indépendants de développement de jeux AAA. People Can Fly is one of the leading independent AAA game development studios. Our international team consists of hundreds of talented individuals working from offices in Poland, the UK, Ireland, the US, and Canada, as well as remotely across the globe.

Founded in 2002, we made our mark on the shooter genre with titles such as Painkiller, Bulletstorm, Gears of War: Judgment, and Outriders. With over 20 years of experience, PCF continues to explore new horizons. We aim to combine our expertise with the creativity of the best and most forward-thinking talent in the industry, building the next generation of action games for players worldwide.

If you join us on this journey, you’ll have the chance to perfect your craft, expand your knowledge, and work alongside industry leaders to create unique, unforgettable experiences for gamers everywhere.

We are looking for an experienced SAP System Architect with strong HR/HCM expertise and solid technical knowledge to lead the design and implementation of the HR Mini Master (HRMM) solution within an SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
The role focuses on the HR data and processes required within S/4HANA, rather than the full SAP HCM suite. You will be responsible for defining the solution architecture, ensuring effective integration with surrounding systems, and supporting the solution throughout implementation and deployment.
What You Will Be Doing

  • Define and own the solution architecture for HR Mini Master (HRMM) in SAP S/4HANA.
  • Design the HRMM solution based on business and technical requirements, including how employee and organizational data is represented and maintained within S/4HANA.
  • Design and oversee integrations between HRMM and SAP and non-SAP systems, workday, including data flows, mappings, interfaces, and relevant integration mechanisms.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable and sustainable functional and technical solution designs.
  • Work closely with HR/HCM functional consultants, integration teams, technical teams, and business stakeholders, providing architectural guidance throughout implementation.
  • Support testing, deployment, cutover, and resolution of technical, data, and integration issues.
  • Review solution designs and maintain architecture and design documentation.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience with SAP HCM / HR and a solid understanding of HR master data and organizational structures.
  • Experience designing or implementing HR Mini Master (HRMM) solutions in SAP S/4HANA.
  • Strong understanding of relevant SAP HCM areas, particularly Personnel Administration (PA) and Organizational Management (OM).
  • Good understanding of how HR master data is used and integrated with other S/4HANA processes.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA solution architecture and integration design.
  • Strong technical understanding of SAP HR/HCM architecture, data structures, interfaces, and integration mechanisms.
  • Good understanding of SAP integration technologies and concepts such as APIs, IDocs, web services, middleware, and data mapping.
  • Ability to work with technical teams to define interface specifications and troubleshoot technical and integration issues.
  • Experience defining integrations between SAP and external HR systems.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into end-to-end solution architecture and technical designs.
  • Experience supporting implementation, testing, deployment, and cutover activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with business, functional, integration, and technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with Workday-to-SAP S/4HANA integration, particularly for employee, organizational, and HR master data.

Added Advantage

  • Knowledge of integration technologies and patterns used between Workday and SAP environments.
  • Knowledge of ABAP and the ability to understand or review technical developments and specifications.

  • Annual Training Budget: Access CHF 1,500 to invest in your professional development and skill enhancement.

  • Global Mobility Support: Gain assistance with international assignments, visa/permit support, and relocation services.

  • People Focus: Unite with the best global talent in life sciences, empowered to grow and collaborate in a vibrant environment.
  • Truly Global: Join a truly global organization where mutual support, teamwork, and diversity drive our collective success.

Swiss Delivery Excellence: Transforming Life Science Consulting Worldwide.

Fusion Consulting is a globally leading Business and IT boutique consultancy specialized in the Life Sciences industry, partnering with leading companies in pharma, healthcare, and animal health.

With over 450 employees and 25 offices worldwide, our mission is to revolutionize our clients' business transformation challenges and set new industry standards through innovative solutions.

The Opportunity:
CACI is seeking a Senior Scrum Master to serve as the facilitator of Agile execution. This role focuses on team-level dynamics, removing operational roadblocks, and coaching the engineering team on DevSecOps culture to maintain a high-velocity development cycle.

You will be responsible for facilitating all Agile ceremonies, sustaining a healthy and predictable Agile cadence, and removing impediments that hinder delivery. Operating as a servant leader, this role enables the team to deliver high-quality software increments while supporting the Product Owner in promoting backlog clarity, prioritization, and value alignment. The Scrum Master fosters collaboration across cross functional teams, coaching them toward maturity, accountability, and continuous improvement.


You will support consistent team-level delivery flow, support sprint execution, coordinate with Product Owners and technical leads, and strengthening alignment between business needs and technical execution at scale. The Scrum Master ensures transparency, supports conflict resolution, reinforces Agile principles, and strengthens alignment between business needs and technical execution.

Responsibilities:
• Facilitating team-level execution and all standard Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
• Collaborating with adjacent teams to manage dependencies and communicate team-level needs.
• Identifying, tracking, and actively removing impediments or obstacles that prevent the team from meeting sprint commitments.
• Tracking, analyzing, and reporting on key agile metrics (e.g., team velocity, sprint burndown, cycle time) alongside traditional service delivery metrics to provide government stakeholders with visibility into team performance.
• Protecting the engineering and development teams from outside distractions and scope creep to maintain focus on committed deliverables.
• Providing team-level coaching on Agile practices and supporting adoption of DevSecOps principles within the team.

• Supporting the Agile team.

Qualifications:

Required:
• Active Secret clearance
• Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years of relevant professional experience.
• Demonstrated experience facilitating Agile/Scrum ceremonies.
• Proficiency in tracking and interpreting Agile metrics.
• Relevant certification such as Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or equivalent Agile/Scrum or PMP certification

Desired:
• Strong coaching capability in DevSecOps culture and Agile methodologies.
• Experience supporting Agile delivery in federal programs, cloud based modernization efforts or DevSecOps programs, or multi team Agile Release Trains.
•Background in facilitating cross functional collaboration, readiness activities, and quality focused delivery patterns.

-

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

PPC Manager

Our Client, Nordzero, an international e-commerce company with a strong presence in the USA, Canada and Europe is looking for a highly skilled and experienced professional to fill an immediate opening for Amazon PPC Manager for a full-time remote job.

As the Amazon PPC Manager, you will be responsible for managing our advertising efforts on Amazon, setting performance goals, elaborating PPC strategies, and ensuring the successful execution of Amazon PPC campaigns to drive sales and maximize profitability.

If you have a strong background in Amazon PPC advertising, exceptional leadership skills, and a passion for driving success in the Ecommerce industry, we would love to hear from you.

About the Company:

At Nordzero we develop and sell products that help boost mood, well-being, beauty, and life quality every day. We want to create long-term added value for society. At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Portfolio Manager - ELIP Business Line EMEA

__

Your role and responsibilities


In this role, you will lead the Product Management function for the Medium Voltage Cable Accessories portfolio across EMEA & Asia. You will define and execute product line strategies, translate market needs into competitive offerings, and drive portfolio growth, profitability, and innovation. Working closely with Sales, R&D, Operations, Marketing and Regional Leadership, you will ensure successful portfolio execution throughout the product lifecycle while contributing to ABB’s strategic growth ambitions.


The work model for the role is: remote #remote


Preferred location: Europe


This role is contributing to the ABB Installation Products Division, Medium Voltage Cable Accessories (ELIP) business in EMEA & Asia. Main stakeholders are the Installation Products Regional Leader, Portfolio Manager, Sales Manager, R&D Manager, Operations Manager, Market Development teams, and regional Sales organizations.


You will be mainly accountable for:


  • Defining and executing the product line strategy and roadmap based on customer needs, market attractiveness, and competitive positioning, aligned with the ELIP EMEA strategy.
  • Building a strong understanding of Medium Voltage cable accessories markets, utility requirements, qualification processes, customer applications, routes to market, and competitive landscape to identify portfolio gaps and growth opportunities.
  • Managing the full product lifecycle, including new product development, launch, profitability optimization, portfolio rationalization, pricing strategy, and phase-out activities.
  • Translating customer and market insights into product requirements, business cases, and development priorities while partnering with R&D to accelerate innovation and product development.
  • Developing and executing product launch and go-to-market strategies, ensuring operational readiness and strong collaboration with Market Development and Sales teams across target markets.
  • Monitoring product line performance through key business metrics, including orders, revenue, profitability, portfolio vitality, and new product sales, while driving corrective actions where required.
  • Evaluating strategic partnerships and potential M&A opportunities to strengthen the portfolio and support long-term business growth.
  • Driving alignment across Sales, Marketing, R&D, Operations, Finance, and Market Development functions to ensure effective execution of portfolio priorities.
  • Leading, coaching, and developing Product Managers, fostering a high-performance culture focused on customer value, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensuring compliance with ABB policies and applicable regulatory, safety, integrity, quality, and sustainability requirements.

Our team dynamics


You will join an international and dynamic team, where you will be able to thrive.


Qualifications for the role


  • 7+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Line Management, New Product Development, Business Development, or related roles within the electrification industry.
  • Proven Medium Voltage experience is required; experience in MV cable accessories, utility markets, and power distribution applications is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of customer needs, market dynamics, industry trends, utility qualification processes, and the ability to translate these into clear product priorities and business opportunities.
  • Demonstrated experience managing product portfolios, product lifecycle activities, new product launches, and go-to-market strategies.
  • Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional teams including Sales, Marketing, R&D, Operations, and Finance in an international environment.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset with the ability to evaluate market opportunities, business performance, and investment decisions.
  • Leadership experience with the ability to coach, develop, and inspire product management teams.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, business, or a related discipline.

More about us

ABB Installation Products Division (formerly Thomas & Betts) helps manage the connection, protection and distribution of electrical power from source to socket. The Division’s products are engineered to provide ease of installation and perform in demanding and harsh conditions, helping to ensure safety and continuous operation for utilities, businesses and people around the world. The Commercial Essentials product segment includes electrical junction boxes, commercial fittings, strut and cable tray metal framing systems for commercial and residential construction. The Premier Industrial product segment includes multiple product lines, such as Ty-Rap® cable ties, T&B Liquidtight Systems® protection products, PVC coated and nylon conduit systems, power connection and grounding systems, and cable protection systems of conduits and fittings for harsh and industrial applications. The Division also manufactures solutions for medium-voltage applications used in the utility market under its marquee brands including Elastimold™ reclosers and switchgear, capacitor switches, current limiting fuses, Homac™ distribution connectors, faulted current indicators, cable accessories, and apparatus for overhead and underground distribution networks. Manufacturing includes both made-to-stock and custom-made solutions.


This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

raw.description:
Job Description Summary

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft der Patientenversorgung bei GE HealthCare
Als Commercial Leader – Acute Care, Monitoring Systems & Anesthesia Germany übernehmen Sie die kommerzielle Gesamtverantwortung für eines der strategisch wichtigsten Wachstumssegmente von GE HealthCare in Deutschland. Sie treiben nachhaltiges Wachstum, stärken unsere Marktposition und entwickeln das Geschäft erfolgreich weiter – in einem dynamischen und zunehmend digitalisierten Gesundheitsmarkt.

In dieser Schlüsselrolle verbinden Sie strategische Markt- und Geschäftsentwicklung mit operativer Exzellenz. Sie führen ein spezialisiertes Vertriebsteam, entwickeln leistungsfähige Go-to-Market-Strategien und bauen sowohl direkte als auch indirekte Vertriebskanäle weiter aus. Gemeinsam mit Kunden, Vertriebspartnern sowie internen und externen Stakeholdern schaffen Sie nachhaltigen Mehrwert für Krankenhäuser, medizinisches Fachpersonal und Patientinnen und Patienten.

Diese Position ist homebased (flexibel innerhalb Deutschlands) mit Reisetätigkeit im gesamten Bundesgebiet.

Bei GE HealthCare machen unsere Geräte, unsere Software, unsere Lösungen, unser Service und unsere Mitarbeitenden für medizinisches Fachpersonal und Patientinnen und Patienten auf der ganzen Welt einen echten Unterschied. Weil wir nie aus den Augen verlieren, was im Gesundheitswesen wirklich zählt – das Menschliche.

Job Description

In dieser Rolle werden Sie:

  • die kommerzielle Gesamtverantwortung für das Geschäftsfeld Acute Care, Monitoring Systems & Anesthesia in Deutschland übernehmen, einschließlich Auftragseingang, Umsatz, Wachstum und Profitabilität
  • die Umsetzung einer ambitionierten Wachstumsstrategie vorantreiben und nachhaltiges Marktwachstum durch konsequente Marktbearbeitung, effektives Funnel-Management und wertorientierte Vertriebsstrategien sicherstellen
  • ein Team aus Sales Specialists, Clinical Specialists und weiteren kommerziellen Funktionen führen, entwickeln und zu einer leistungsstarken Organisation ausbauen
  • Markt-, Segment- und Go-to-Market-Strategien entwickeln und umsetzen, um Marktanteile auszubauen und neue Wachstumspotenziale zu erschließen
  • die Marktabdeckung durch den konsequenten Ausbau indirekter Vertriebskanäle und strategischer Partnernetzwerke erweitern – insbesondere im Einstiegs- und Mid-Market-Segment
  • eine Kultur der konsequenten Neukunden Acquisition etablieren und neue Kundenpotenziale systematisch erschließen
  • die erfolgreiche Kommerzialisierung neuer Produkte, ggf. lokale Portfolio Ergänzungen, Softwarelösungen und digitaler Innovationen verantworten und deren Markteinführung beschleunigen
  • strategische Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen, pflegen und weiterentwickeln, um langfristiges Wachstum und hohe Kundenzufriedenheit sicherzustellen
  • Markttrends, Kundenanforderungen und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen analysieren und daraus wirksame Maßnahmen für die Geschäftsentwicklung ableiten
  • bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit mit angrenzenden Geschäftsbereichen fördern und Synergien insbesondere mit Diagnostic Cardiology (DCAR), High Acute Care (HAC) und dem technischen Service aktiv nutzen
  • die Vertriebsperformance anhand valider Forecasts, transparenter Steuerungsmechanismen und klar definierter KPIs aktiv managen
  • eng mit Marketing, Service, Finance, Operations sowie regionalen und internationalen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten, um die Geschäftsstrategie erfolgreich umzusetzen

​

Das bringen Sie mit:

  • Sie verfügen über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Medizintechnik, Gesundheitsmanagement oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
  • Sie bringen fundierte Erfahrung in kommerziellen Führungspositionen im Umfeld Medizintechnik im Klinkmarkt mit
  • Sie haben nachweisbare Erfolge in der Entwicklung von Wachstumsmärkten sowie in der Verantwortung für Umsatz, Profitabilität und Geschäftsentwicklung
  • Sie sind erfahren in der Führung und Weiterentwicklung leistungsstarker Vertriebsorganisationen
  • Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Management komplexer Vertriebsprozesse sowie im Aufbau und der Steuerung indirekter Vertriebskanäle und Partnernetzwerke mit
  • Sie bringen Erfahrung in der Einführung und Kommerzialisierung neuer Produkte und Lösungen mit
  • Sie haben ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis des deutschen Gesundheitsmarktes sowie relevanter Marktmechanismen, Einkaufsstrukturen und klinischer Entscheidungsprozesse
  • Ausgeprägte analytische und strategische Fähigkeiten kombiniert mit hoher Kunden-, Wachstums- und Ergebnisorientierung zeichnen Sie aus
  • Sie bringen starke Kommunikations- und Einflussfähigkeiten mit sowie die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder auf gemeinsame Ziele auszurichten
  • Sie haben die Fähigkeit, komplexe Markt- und Geschäftssituationen in klare Prioritäten und umsetzbare Maßnahmen zu übersetzen
  • Sie bringen hohe Eigeninitiative, Freude zu gestalten und hohes unternehmerisches Denken mit
  • Sie sind bereit zu regelmäßigen Dienstreisen innerhalb Deutschlands und verfügen über verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Onlinebewerbung!

Über uns

GE HealthCare ist ein global führender Innovator für Medizintechnik und digitale Lösungen mit mehr als 100 Jahren Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen und rund 50.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit. Wir ermöglichen es klinischen Anwendern, schnellere und besser informiertere Entscheidungen zu treffen durch intelligente Systeme, Datenanalyse, Anwendungen und Services, die durch unsere Edison Platform unterstützt sind. Wir agieren im Zentrum eines Ökosystems einer Präzisionsmedizin, die das Gesundheitswesen digitaler gestaltet - für mehr Produktivität und bessere Ergebnisse für Patienten, Anbieter im Gesundheitswesen, ganze Gesundheitssysteme und die Forschung weltweit.

Unsere GE HealthCare Total Rewards sind dazu entwickelt worden, Sie zu Höchstleistungen zu inspirieren. Sie geben Ihnen den notwendigen Rückenwind und die Flexibilität, die Sie brauchen, um Ihre Ideen Realität werden zu lassen. Unsere Gehälter und Bonussysteme sind genau so, wie Sie es von einem Global Player in der Medizintechnik erwarten und Sie sind bei uns umgeben von Möglichkeiten in einer Unternehmenskultur, in der das füreinander Einsetzen, Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitige Unterstützung an erster Stelle stehen.

GE HealthCare ist ein Arbeitgeber mit gleichen Chancen für alle. Wir leben eine Kultur wo jeder dazu gehört und Personalentscheidungen werden bei uns unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion und Weltanschauung, Bekenntnis, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechteridentität, Alter, Behinderung und anderer gesetzlich geschützter Persönlichkeitsrechte getroffen.

GE HealthCare – Creating a world where healthcare has no limits
